scripts.text:
[Vincent]
You're inside Sir Zhed's
looking for new employees,
I don't think you're suited
for this kind of domestic
work, brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
您是在泽德大人这里寻找新雇员的吧？
恕我直言，勇敢的冒险者，
您并不适合这种家内的工作。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I am Vincert, steward of
this mansion and faithful
servant to its master, Sir
Zhed, the most powerful
man in all of Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我是文森特，这座宅邸的管家，
也是主人泽德大人的忠实仆人。
他是阿鲁纳菲兹最有权势的人。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
My master is currently out
to attend the High Priest
assembly, and has been gone
for a few days. I would like to
ask you for your help with
a problem on his behalf.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我的主人目前正在外出参加神官集会，
已经离开几天了。
我想请您帮忙处理一件麻烦事。

scripts.text: I'm too busy.
scripts.translation: 我太忙了。

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么不呢？

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I understand.
I'm sorry that you're
too busy at the moment...
If you should be available
later, then I'd like to ask for
your assistance once again.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我明白了。
很抱歉，您现在太忙了……
如果您之后有空，
希望能再次得到您的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Thank you. You see,
the pope awarded Sir Zhed
for his great contributions to
Arunafeltz with a precious gem.
However, this jewel is missing
and I need your help to find it.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
谢谢您。是这样的，
教皇为了表彰泽德大人对阿鲁纳菲兹的巨大贡献，
赠送了一块珍贵的宝石。
然而，这块宝石不见了，
我需要您的帮助找到它。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I don't have any proof, but
I suspect it was stolen by
Phobe, a servant that
disappeared about the same
time the gem disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我没有任何证据，
但我怀疑是菲比偷走的。
他是一名仆人，
在宝石失窃前后失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Please retrieve this gem
and find who stole it before
Sir Zhed returns and finds
out what happened. If you
can keep this secret, I'd
very much appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
请在泽德大人回来发现真相之前，
找回这块宝石并查明是谁偷的。
如果您能保守这个秘密，
我将不胜感激。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I believe that you'd want
to interrogate Phobe, but
he has run away somewhere.
You might want to question the
other servants of his whereabouts. Thanks again for your help.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我想您大概想审问菲比，
但他已经逃走了。
您可能需要询问其他仆人他的下落。
再次感谢您的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I suggest looking around
the mansion and asking the
servants for any clues about
Phobe's current location.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我建议您在宅邸周围转转，
并向仆人询问关于菲比现下落的线索。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
We're running out
of time... Please find
the gem and Phobe
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
时间不多了……
请尽快找到宝石和菲比。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Ah...!
H-hello! How are
you still, er... That
look on your face? Did
you happen to find Logan?
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
啊……！
您、您好！您还……
您脸上那是什么表情？
您碰巧找到洛根了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No! I actually got
stabbed by Mogan, and
then we had a talk. What's
the big idea? I come to help
you, and you try to have me
killed! I want an explanation!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不！我其实被莫根刺伤了，
然后我们谈了谈。你这是什么意思？
我来帮你，你却想让我去死！
我要一个解释！

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I... Yes, you deserve
the truth after wh-what
I tried to do to you. First
of all, Phobe is my son, but
please don't tell anybody!
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我……是的，在我对您做了那样的事之后，
您有权知道真相。
首先，菲比是我的儿子，
但请不要告诉任何人！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?
Why, what's
the big deal?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？
为什么，这有什么大不了的？

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
There's something of
a class system here in
Arunafeltz. No one talks
about it, but those that
immigrated here and built this
city are the dominant class.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
阿鲁纳菲兹这里存在着某种阶级制度。
没有人谈论它，但那些移民到这里并建立这座城市的
人是统治阶级。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
The native people are
second class citizens that
are looked down upon by the
descendents of the settlers
that developed this city. It
is a sad, undeniable truth.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
本地人是二等公民，
受到那些开发这座城市的定居者后代的轻视。
这是一个令人悲哀且不可否认的事实。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
The native people typically
suffer from lower class status,
and usually do the hard, blue
collar work in the city. Jenny,
Phobe's mother, is one of them.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
本地人通常地位较低，
通常从事城市中艰苦的体力劳动。
珍妮，菲比的母亲，就是其中之一。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
It's taboo for me to love her,
especially since Sir Zhed has
taken me under his wing and
been like a father to me. If
I married her, it'd greatly
damage his reputation.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我爱她是禁忌，
尤其是因为泽德大人收留了我，
待我如父亲一般。
如果我娶了她，
会严重损害他的名声。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I tried to control my
feelings but... Well,
Phobe was born. And there's
no going back now. We did
get secretly married though,
and I don't regret that.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我试图控制我的感情，但是……
总之，菲比出生了。现在已无法回头。
不过我们确实秘密结婚了，
我不后悔这一点。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Phobe must resent me...
I've had to treat him and
his mother like slaves
in front of other people.
I know it's horrible... To be
so cold to those you love.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
菲比一定很怨恨我……
我不得不把我和他母亲
在别人面前当作奴隶对待。
我知道这很可怕……
对自己爱的人如此冷漠。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
When he ran off with the
jewel, I was actually more
worried about Phobe than
my master's treasure. So...
I did what I could to try to
get him back: I hired you.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
当他带着宝石逃跑时，
我其实更担心菲比，
而不是师父的宝物。所以……
我尽力去把他找回来：
我雇了你。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
However, once you found
Phobe, I planned to have
you killed so that we could
blame you for the theft. I'm
sorry, I know it's wrong, but
I was so worried about my boy!
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
然而，一旦你找到了菲比，
我计划让你被杀，
这样我们就可以把盗窃的罪名推到你身上。
对不起，我知道这不对，
但我太担心我的孩子了！

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I hope you forgive me...
I'll do what I should've
done from the beginning...
I'll take full responsibility
for the gem's theft, and Sir
Zhed can do to me what he will.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
希望你能原谅我……
我会做我一开始就该做的事……
我会对宝石的失窃负全责，
泽德大人想对我怎样都行。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
The gem is very special...
Our pope commanded my
master to keep the jewel
safely, as it has the power
to save Arunafeltz and Rachel
when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
这颗宝石非常特别……
教皇命令我的师父妥善保管它，
因为它拥有在关键时刻
拯救阿鲁纳菲兹和拉赫的力量。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The gem is really that
important, huh? Well, you
almost had me killed, but
since I'm still alive, I guess
I can overlook it, you know?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这颗宝石真的那么重要吗？
好吧，你差点让我死了，
但既然我还活着，
我想我可以原谅你，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You won't get in trouble
if I can find the jewel and
Phobe before Sir Zhed
returns, so I'll try to find
them for you as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我在泽德大人回来之前
找到宝石和菲比，你就不会惹上麻烦，
所以我会尽快帮你找到他们。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
You're willing to
do that for me? ^333333*Sob*^000000
Even after what I've put
you through? ^333333*Sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
你愿意为我做这些吗？^333333*抽泣*^000000
在我让你经历了这一切之后？^333333*吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh, I went through all
this trouble already, so
I might as well finish the
job. Besides, Phobe is
just a kid, so he's probably
hiding somewhere in town.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，我已经费了这么大劲，
不如就把这件事做完吧。
而且，菲比只是个小孩，
他可能正躲在镇上的某个地方。

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，我已经费了这么大劲，
不如就把这件事做完吧。
而且，菲比只是个小孩，
他可能正躲在镇上的某个地方……

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
You came back!
Were you able to
find Phobe?! H-how
is he? Is he alright?
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
你回来了！
你找到菲比了吗？！他……他怎么样了？
他没事吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Oh yeah, he's
just fine. I found Phobe
loitering around Freya's
Spring. Er, he's not willing
to come home yet, but he did
give me the gem he stole.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊？哦对，他没事。
我在弗蕾雅之泉附近发现菲比在闲逛。
呃，他暂时不想回家，
但他把偷走的宝石还给我了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So... I earned my
reward now, right?
And no one has to die?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么……我现在可以拿到我的报酬了吧？
而且不用死人？

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Yes, yes, thank you so
much! I'll never forget
what you've done for me.
Oh, my boy is alright!
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
是的，是的，非常感谢！
我永远不会忘记你为我所做的一切。
哦，我的孩子没事！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
H-hey! Um, take
this jewel! You need
to return it to wherever
it's supposed to go, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿！呃，拿着这颗宝石！
你需要把它送回它该去的地方，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Oh, yes, I'd better do
that. While I return this
jewel, would you please
tell my wife Jenny that our
boy is okay? She's been
very worried about him, so...
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
哦，是的，我最好这么做。
在我归还这颗宝石的时候，
你能帮我告诉我的妻子珍妮，
我们的孩子没事吗？
她一直非常担心他，所以……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You want me to tell
Jenny about Phobe?
Sure, sure, I'll do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想让我告诉珍妮关于菲比的事？
当然，当然，我会去做的。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Oh! While I return this
jewel, would you please
tell my wife Jenny that our
boy is okay? She's been
very worried about him, so...
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
哦！在我归还这颗宝石的时候，
你能帮我告诉我的妻子珍妮，
我们的孩子没事吗？
她一直非常担心他，所以……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You want me to tell
Jenny about Phobe?
Sure, sure, I'll do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想让我告诉珍妮关于菲比的事？
当然，当然，我会去做的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I told Jenny that
about Phobe, and that
the gem was returned...
She seemed pretty relieved...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我告诉珍妮关于菲比的事，
以及宝石已经归还……
她似乎松了一口气……

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Thank you so much,
adventurer. She's such
a kind, loving woman, and
I hate to see her go through
all that torment. I don't deserve
such a beautiful woman...
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
非常感谢你，冒险者。
她是个善良、充满爱心的女人，
我不忍心看她经历那么多痛苦。
我不配拥有这么美丽的女人……

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
It's very fortunate that
you've come to save us...
Please drop by the next
time that you're in Rachel,
and I'll try to help you if I can.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
你能来救我们真是太幸运了……
下次你来拉赫的时候，
请顺便过来，我会尽力帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Ah, actually, I have
one last favor to ask
of you. Would you please
bring this note and package
to my master? He should still
be in the temple right now.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
啊，其实我还有最后一件事想拜托你。
能否请你把这封信和包裹
带给我的师父？
他现在应该还在神殿里。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
If you ask for High
Priest Zhed and mention
that I sent you, then he
will meet with you.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
如果你去找大祭司泽德，
并说明是我派你来的，
他就会见你。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Now is the time for
me to give you your
reward. How about that?
I don't know what's inside,
but I know these items are
quite valuable nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
现在该给你奖励了。
怎么样？
我不知道里面是什么，
但我知道这些东西现在很值钱……

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Ah, and this note is a
letter of recommendation
that I have written for you.
Please deliver it to Sir Zhed
as soon as possible. Good bye,
and thank you for everything.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
啊，这封信是我为你写的推荐信。
请尽快把它交给泽德大人。
再见，感谢你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a letter
of recommendation
from Vincent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了
文森特给的推荐信。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Thank you for everything
that you've done for me
and my family. If you ever
need help, please don't
hesitate to ask me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
谢谢你为我
和我的家人所做的一切。
如果你需要帮助，
请尽管开口，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Logan]
I'm just Logan, one
of the many servants
working here in Sir Zhed's
glorious mansion. I've got
a lot of work to do, so don't
don't distract me, please.
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
我只是洛根，
在泽德大人宏伟的宅邸里
工作的众多仆人之一。
我有很多工作要做，
请不要打扰我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but do
you know man named
Phobe by any chance?
I heard that he used
to work around here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，请问你认识
一个叫菲比的男子吗？
我听说他以前在这里工作。

scripts.text:
[Logan]
Er, may I ask
you are? Why are
you looking for him?
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
呃，请问你是？
你为什么在找他？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I've just been
hired to look for him,
and I was told that asking
the servants around here
was a good starting point.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我刚被雇来寻找他，
有人告诉我，
先问问这里的仆人
是个不错的开始。

scripts.text:
[Logan]
Oh, okay. Yeah, Phobe's
been missing ever since
he left to buy stuff from
the market a few days ago.
I hope the kid is alright.
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
哦，好的。是的，菲比
自从几天前去市场买东西后
就失踪了。
希望那个小孩没事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Er, kid? Just
how old is Phobe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，小孩？
菲比到底多大了？

scripts.text:
[Logan]
He just turned fifteen.
That's all I know about
him. Truth be told, I don't
know much since I just
started working here. Why don't
you ask the senior employees?
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
他刚满十五岁。
关于他我只知道这些。
说实话，我刚开始在这里工作，
所以不太了解。你为什么不问问
资深员工呢？

scripts.text:
[Logan]
Let's see...
You could ask Mr. Manson
inside the mansion. He's
been working here for a while.
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
让我想想……
你可以问问宅邸里的曼森先生。
他在这里工作有一段时间了。

scripts.text:
[Logan]
If you want to learn
more about Phobe, you'd
better ask one of the senior
employees since I just started
working here. Mr. Manson in
the mansion is a good bet.
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
如果你想了解更多关于菲比的事，
最好问问资深员工，
因为我刚开始在这里工作。
宅邸里的曼森先生是个不错的选择。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
I am Manson, one of the
many servants working here
in Sir Zhed's mansion. Er,
would you be more careful
walking around here? I hate
cleaning up after visitors.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
我是曼森，在泽德大人的宅邸里
工作的众多仆人之一。呃，
你能不能走路小心点？
我不喜欢清理访客留下的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
You know, considering
that natives like me are
looked down upon and
are kinda of lower class,
I'm really lucky to work for
Sir Zhed here in the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
你知道吗，考虑到像我这样的原住民
被看不起，
地位也比较低，
我能在泽德大人的宅邸里工作
真的很幸运。

He's gone missing, so I've
been hired to look for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，请问你认识

他失踪了，所以我被雇来寻找他。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
Ah, so you're the one
that Vincent hired, huh?
That's good, that's good.
I'm pretty sure Phobe is
hiding somewhere and
just goofing around.
scripts.translation:

啊，原来你是文森特雇来的啊？
那就好，那就好。
我相当确定菲比只是躲在某个地方
玩而已。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
I'm sure he can take care
of himself, so we won't have
to worry too much. Let's see,
he asked me if I had any
errands to for him to do,
so I sent him to the market.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
我相信他能照顾好自己，
所以我们不用太担心。
让我想想，
他问我有没有什么差事让他去办，
所以我派他去市场了。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
That's the last time I saw
him. I guess he's using the
money I gave him to feed himself
while he's run away. He's young,
so I can't really blame him.
We've all done crazy things~
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
那是最后一次见到他。
我想他大概是用我给他的钱
在逃跑期间填饱肚子吧。
他还年轻，所以我不能怪他。
我们谁没做过疯狂的事呢~

scripts.text:
[Manson]
Ah, our gardener Jenny
was the one that introduced
me to him. She's worked for
Sir Zhed for a long time, and
she loves kids. I guess she's
got a soft spot for Phobe.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
啊，是我们的园丁珍妮
把我介绍给他的。
她在泽德大人这里工作很久了，
而且她很喜欢孩子。
我想她对菲比特别关照。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
No one knows who his
parents are, so I guess
he's an orphan. That's
probably why she has him.
working with us in the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
没人知道他的父母是谁，
所以他大概是个孤儿。
也许这就是为什么她让他
在府邸里为我们工作。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
Jenny has done a lot for
that boy. We skipped our
usual employment process
just for her, you know? And
now Jenny and even Vincent
are worried about him missing.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
珍妮为那个男孩做了很多。
你知道的，我们甚至
为了她跳过了常规的雇佣流程。
现在珍妮甚至文森特
都担心他失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
You know, if you want to
know more about that kid,
you should talk to Jenny.
She's working in the garden
now, and she'd appreciate
your help in finding Phobe.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
你知道吗，如果你想了解更多
关于那个孩子的事，
你应该去和珍妮谈谈。
她现在正在花园里工作，
她会感激你帮忙寻找菲比的。

无法完成所有事情。
唉，混口饭吃嘛。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]

Sir Zhed and are considered
private property. Please
leave immediately if you
haven't been invited!
scripts.translation:

这片土地属于泽德大人，

market? That's where

of where he was going?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[{0}]

Alright, I guess I can go
to the market and ask around.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...这是个好主意。

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
宝石已经归还了，

另外，文森特
把一切都告诉我了。
你知道，
你、他和菲比
都有血缘关系，所以...

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Oh! Oh, I see. He told
you our secret? Well,
I guess we can trust you.
Mostly, I'm just relieved
that my son is alright, and
that he won't get in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
哦！哦，我明白了。
他告诉了你我们的秘密？
好吧，我想我们可以信任你。
我主要是松了一口气，
我的儿子没事，
而且他不会惹上麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Anyway, even though Phobe
is being pretty stubborn,
I'm sure he'll come back
soon. As he grows up, I think
he'll understand his father's
position a little bit better.
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
总之，虽然菲比
现在很固执，
但我相信他很快就会回来的。
随着他长大，
我想他会更理解
他父亲处境的。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
I hope so. Although
it's been very hard for
all three of us to live
this way, I couldn't be
happier. Thank you for
all of your help, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
希望如此。虽然
我们三个人这样生活
非常艰难，
但我再开心不过了。
谢谢你所有的帮助，
冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Thank you so much for
finding my son. If there's
anything I can ever do for
you, please let me know.
You don't know how grateful
I am to you as a mother...
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
非常感谢你
找到了我的儿子。
如果有什么我能帮你的，
请告诉我。
你不知道我作为母亲
有多感激你...

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Man! Business is going
sooo slooow right now!
Well, no point standing
around this dump much
longer. Maybe I should
pack it up and go home.
scripts.translation:
[闲散的商人]
天哪！生意
现在慢得不得了！
好吧，在这个鬼地方
站久了也没意义。
也许我该收拾东西
回家了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me?
Hello? Sir?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下？
你好？先生？

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Finally! A customer!
I knew someone would come
eventually! So whaddya want
to buy? I got all sorts of
handy little knickknacks~
scripts.translation:
[闲散的商人]
终于！有顾客了！
我就知道迟早会有人来的！
那么你想买点什么？
我这儿有各种各样
实用的小玩意儿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry, not interested.
I just wanted to ask if
you've seen a boy around
here that's about fifteen
years old. He supposedly
ran away from home, so.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，不感兴趣。
我只是想问问
你最近有没有见过
一个大约十五岁的男孩。
听说他离家出走了。

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Fifteen? My own son is
that age... I'm sorry, but
I haven't seen any lads that
age around here in the past
few days. Though, you might
want to ask the other merchants.
scripts.translation:
[闲散的商人]
十五岁？我儿子
也是那个年纪...抱歉，
这几天我没在这里
见过那个年纪的男孩。
不过，
你可以问问其他商人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Cool. Thanks a lot.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Alright, then!
Good luck bringing that
boy home! Oh, and are you
sure that you don't want
to take a look around?
scripts.translation:
[闲散的商人]
好的！
祝你顺利把那个男孩
带回家！哦，还有，
你确定不想
看看我的货吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

you sell here? I can't
recognize any of these
goods that you're selling.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，你这里
具体卖什么？
我认不出
你卖的这些商品。

offer dishes with mock meat
made out of vegetables and
stuff like wheat gluten, right?
scripts.translation:
[闲散的商人]
你知道有些餐厅
提供用蔬菜
和面筋之类的
做的仿肉菜吗？

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]

made out of pure meat! Now
how's that for the best of both
worlds? Yeah? Yeah? Here,
why don't you try a sample?
scripts.translation:
[闲散的商人]
听好了：
用纯肉做的仿蔬菜！
这难道不是
两全其美吗？对吧？对吧？
来，
尝尝样品吧？

[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.translation:

宝贵的氧气！

scripts.translation:

嘿呀！

wounded you with a throwing
dagger, and then threw another
one that you managed to dodge.

用投掷短剑伤了你，

I guess I underestimated
you! You're a lot stronger

surprise, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
啊！我...
我低估你了！
你比被偷袭时强多了，

you?! Are you Rogan?
Are you the one that
kidnapped Phobe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你他妈的是谁？！
你是罗根吗？

kidnap nobody! I don't

just hired to kill you and
bring your body to my client.

scripts.translation:

什...什么？我没有

交给我的雇主。

scripts.text:

Vincent's instructions
were to kill anyone that
asked about Rogan, some
name he made up. My name
is Mogan. Gosh... I thought
you were a really bad guy.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
文森特的指示是
杀死任何询问罗根的人，
那是他编造的名字。
我的名字是莫根。天哪...
我以为你是个很坏的人。

scripts.text:

here. Did you steal
something really
valuable, like some
red jewel or something?
scripts.translation:
[莫根]
嘿，给我解释清楚。
你偷了什么非常值钱的东西，
比如大红宝石之类的吗？

[{0}]
Huh? No! Vincent actually
sent me to look for the guy
that stole that jewel, and
to retrieve it for him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？不！文森特
实际上是派我来找
偷了那颗宝石的人，
并为他取回它！

scripts.text:
[Mogan]
It looks like he set
us up, dude. That's...
That's really low. Sorry,
if I had known, I wouldn't
have done it. Why would
he manipulate us like that?
scripts.translation:
[莫根]
看来是他设局害了我们，老兄。这...这太卑鄙了。抱歉，如果我知道的话，我就不会这么做了。他为什么要那样利用我们？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know...
I'm going to talk
to Vincent and make
him explain everything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道...
我要去找文森特，让他把一切都解释清楚。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
别管我！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou catch a shining
glint from this boy's
back pocket. Perhaps he
has the jewel that Vincent
wants you to retrieve.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你从这个男孩的后口袋里看到一道闪光。也许他正藏着文森特让你取回的那颗宝石。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, you.
You must be
Phobe, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你。
你一定是菲比，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Yeah?
So what?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
是又怎样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your father sent
me here to find you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你父亲派我
来这里找你。

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
No! Don't touch me!
I have no father!
H-he's dead to me!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
不！别碰我！
我没有父亲！
他...他对我来说已经死了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, in any case, I need
to return the jewel that
you're hiding in your pocket.
I know that it really belongs
to Sir Zhed.  If I don't, then
your father will be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，我需要
取回你藏在口袋里的宝石。
我知道它其实属于泽德爵士。
如果我不取回它，
你父亲就会有麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
Hah! You mean ''Mister
Vincent!'' That's fine
by me! That's exactly
why I took this thing!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
哈！你是说“文森特先生”吧！
那正好！
这就是我拿走它的理由！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, yeah? How do you
think Ms. Jenny will
feel? Do you think
that she'll be happy
hearing about this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，是吗？你觉得
珍妮小姐会怎么想？
你觉得她听到这件事
会高兴吗？

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
..............................
...So you know about
our family secret, huh?
Alright, I'll give this to
you. But I'm doing this for
my mom, and not for him!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
..............................
...原来你知道
我们家的秘密，是吗？
好吧，我把它给你。
但我这么做是为了我妈妈，
不是为了他！

scripts.text:
^3355FFPhobe gingerly pulls
the shining red jewel
from his pocket and
reluctantly hands it to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF菲比小心翼翼地从口袋里
掏出那颗闪闪发光的大红宝石，
不情愿地递给了你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
Just so you know,
I don't plan on going
back home! Well, just
not this second anyway.
But let my mom know that
I'm fine and not to worry.
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
告诉你一声，
我暂时不打算回家！
至少现在不回去。
但请告诉我妈妈我很好，
让她别担心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, I'll tell your mom
But you should be getting
back to them soon. Your
father took a really big
risk covering up for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我会告诉你妈妈。
但你最好快点回去。
你父亲为了替你掩盖这件事，
冒了很大的风险。

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
Hmpf! I...
I don't care!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
哼！我...
我才不在乎！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't look like
you can force Phobe to
return home for now, so
you should bring this red
jewel back to Vincent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看来现在你无法强迫菲比回家，
所以你应该把这颗大红宝石
带回给文森特。^000000

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
I... I'm not ready
to go back home just
fine, and let Mister Vincent
know that I'm not sorry
for what I did, okay?!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
我...我还没准备好
回家。还有，告诉文森特先生，
我对我所做的事一点也不后悔，
听到了吗？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't look like
you can force Phobe to
return home for now, so
you should bring this red
jewel back to Vincent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看来现在你无法强迫菲比回家，
所以你应该把这颗大红宝石
带回给文森特。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know, you should
quit making trouble and
listen to your parents.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗，你应该
少惹点麻烦，
听你父母的话。

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
You're not the boss
of me! Mind your own
business! Jeez louise!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
你管不了我！
管好你自己吧！
真是的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't mind my own
business if your actions
are causing this much trouble
to so many other people! You
need to act more responsibly!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你的行为
给这么多人
带来这么多麻烦，
我怎么可能
不管闲事！
你得对自己
的行为负责！

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
Mmmrrrr...
Gosh... Fine.
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
呜...
真是的...
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
If I had only turned
myself in... Maybe if I had
made an effort to pay for
my crime, me and Bruspetti
could have had a chance...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
如果当时
我自首了...
也许如果我
努力偿还
我的罪孽，
我和布鲁斯佩蒂
还有机会...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Please... Please just
leave me alone. I've lost
the woman I love because
of something stupid I did
in the past. If you want to
turn me in, go ahead...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
求求你...
请别管我了。
因为我过去
做的一件蠢事，
我失去了
我爱的女人。
如果你想
把我交出去，
那就去吧...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I suppose it's my
fate to bear this guilt.
It's already destroyed my
best chance of ever being
truly happy. Bruspetti...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我想，背负
这份罪孽
是我的命运。
它已经毁掉了
我获得真正
幸福的机会。
布鲁斯佩蒂...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I suppose there's
no reason to hide
anything anymore...
You've probably figured
the important stuff by now...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我想，现在
没什么好隐瞒
的了...
你大概已经
猜到了
重要的事...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I used to work as one
of the security guards in
Lighthalzen. We basically
watched the border between
the rich area and the slums.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我以前是
里希塔乐镇
的保安之一。
我们基本上
负责看守
富人区和贫民窟
之间的边界。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I actually was ordered
to kill someone that was
repeatedly moving between
the slums and the rich area.
He was a wealthy kid...
Didn't really deserve it.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我实际上
接到命令，
要杀一个
在贫民窟和
富人区之间
频繁出入的人。
他是个富家子弟...
其实并不该死。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I was paid a lot of money
to do it. At first, I thought
I was just doing my job. You
know, I mean, the law was on
my side. But the boy's blood
wouldn't wash off my hands...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我收了
很多钱
才做的。
起初，我以为
自己只是在
履行职务。
你知道，
法律站在我
这一边。但那个
男孩的血
怎么也洗不掉...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I was scared to kill him,
but once I did it, the guilt
and the torment has been
unbearable! I haven't been
able to sleep... That's why
I had to leave Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我害怕
杀他，但
一旦做了，
那种愧疚
和折磨就
难以忍受！
我再也
睡不着了...
所以我不得不
离开里希塔乐镇。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Bruspetti shocked me when
she had learned about what
I did back then. My one true
love... She couldn't bear the
truth. When she heard it from
my own lips, she went mad...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
布鲁斯佩蒂
得知我当年
做的事后
非常震惊。
我唯一的
真爱...
她无法接受
真相。当她
从我嘴里
听到时，
她疯了...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I couldn't stop her...
I struggled, and tried to
save her, but she managed
to drown herself in Freya's
Spring. She's gone from my
life. Just like that. Forever.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我拦不住她...
我挣扎着，
试图救她，
但她还是
在芙蕾雅之泉
淹死了。
她从我
的生活中
消失了。
就这样。
永远地。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I came here after
killing a man to start
a new life, maybe get
a clean slate, but I end up
indirectly killing the woman
I love. Why God?! Why?!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我杀了一个人
后来到这里，
想开始
新生活，
也许能
重新开始，
结果却间接
害死了
我爱的女人。
为什么，神啊？！
为什么？！

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Are you happy now?
Are you happy now that?
I've told you the truth?
Doesn't that make me and
you feel so much better?!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
你现在
开心了吗？
我告诉你
真相，你
开心了吗？
这难道不会
让你和我
都感觉
好受一点吗？！

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
...............................
God! My life sucks!

[Katinshuell]
^333333*Pant pant*^000000
After all this
time... I thought
I could run away...
But the voices still
h-haunt me... Ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
^333333*喘气*^000000
过了这么久...
我以为
我可以
逃掉...
但那些声音
还在
折磨我... 哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I...
I don't deserve this!
Why do you keep hounding
me with these questions?
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我...
我不该
受这些！
你为什么
一直用这些
问题
纠缠我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did... Did something
happen when Bruspetti
confronted you at Freya's
Spring? What did exactly
did she learn about
you in Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当布鲁斯佩蒂
在芙蕾雅之泉
质问你时，
发生了什么？
她在里希塔乐镇
到底
知道了
关于你的
什么事？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I... I don't have
to tell you anything!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我...我不用
告诉你
任何事！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How can you say that?!
I just read in Bruspetti's
diary that she learned
something horrible about
you, and it involved a
Knife... just like this one.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你怎么能
这么说？！
我刚在
布鲁斯佩蒂的
日记里读到，
她得知了
关于你的
可怕事情，
而且涉及
一把刀...
就像
这把一样。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
.........!
.............
NOoo! I'm sorry, it's
my fault! I was desperate!
You don't understand how
I used to live, you d-don't--!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
.........!
.............
不...不！对不起，是我的错！我当时太绝望了！
你...你不懂我以前是怎么活的，你...你不懂——！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
Mr. Katinshuell?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
卡廷舒尔先生？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I...
I don't deserve this!
Why do you keep hounding
me with these questions?
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我...
我不该
受这些！
你为什么
一直用这些
问题
纠缠我？

scripts.translation:

当布鲁斯佩蒂

质问你时，
发生了什么？
她在里希塔乐镇
到底
知道了
关于你的
什么事？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I... I don't have
to tell you anything!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
我...我不用
告诉你
任何事！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333He's still resisting
me... How can I get
him to reveal the truth?^000000)

[{0}]
Let's see...
Oh this entry looks
interesting. It's all
about you, Katinshuell.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我看看...
哦，这一条看起来很有趣。
全都在写你，卡廷舒尔。

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXX -
I'm so in love with him,
but he always changes the
subject whenever I ask him
personal questions about his
past. Could it be that he's
hiding something from me?
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXX -
我这么爱他，
但每次我问起他过去的私事，
他总是转移话题。
难道他在对我隐瞒什么吗？

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXX -
Is it another woman?
I can't help but feel
jealous! I need to know.
That's why I've decided to
go to Lighthalzen and see
what I can find out.
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXX -
是别的女人吗？
我忍不住感到嫉妒！我必须知道。
所以我决定去里希塔乐镇，
看看能查出什么。

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXO -
Dear Diary,
Today I just learned
the horrible truth... I need
to make him confess it to
me. I hope we can still be
together after all of this...
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXO -
亲爱的日记，
今天我得知了可怕的真相...
我必须让他向我坦白。
希望经历这一切后，
我们还能在一起...

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXO -
But I don't know if
I can live with this!
The man I love... It's
unthinkable that he'd
use a Knife t-to... I just
want to throw up.
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXO -
但我不知道我能否忍受这一切！
我深爱的男人...他居然用那把刀去...简直不可思议。
我简直想吐。

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXO -
I'm planning to meet him
tomorrow at Freya's Spring.
I can't help but look at him
differently now, but still...
He's the man I truly love.
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXO -
我计划明天在芙蕾雅之泉见他。
我现在看他的眼神都不一样了，但即便如此...
他依然是我真正深爱的男人。

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXO -
I hope that I have
good news the next
time I write in this diary...
Well, here's hoping.
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXO -
希望下次写日记时，
我能有一些好消息...
好吧，但愿如此。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, that was
the very last page...
What happened when
Bruspetti confronted
you at Freya's Spring?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这就是最后一页了...
布鲁斯佩蒂在芙蕾雅之泉质问你时，
发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Damn it! I don't want to
think about her anymore!
Get away from me, and take
Bruspetti's diary with you!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
该死！我不想再想起她了！
离我远点，把布鲁斯佩蒂的日记本带走！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?! No way, not after
that little outburst about
killing or not killing Bruspetti!
Fine, if you're not going to
talk, then I'm going to flip
through this diary for answers.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？！
在你刚才那番关于杀或不杀布鲁斯佩蒂的爆发之后，
怎么可能！
好吧，如果你不肯说，那我就翻翻这本日记找答案。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Ha ha ha...
Is this some sort
of interrogation?
I-I've done nothing
wrong! Go ahead,
ask me anything!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
哈哈...
这是在审讯我吗？
我...我什么都没做错！
尽管问吧，问什么都行！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright then, why
don't you explain this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那好吧，你解释一下这个？

scripts.text: Mr. Shendar's House
scripts.translation: 申达尔先生的家

scripts.text: Lighthalzen
scripts.translation: 里希塔乐镇

scripts.text: Freya's Spring
scripts.translation: 芙蕾雅之泉

scripts.text: Bruspetti
scripts.translation: 布鲁斯佩蒂

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Shendar, Bruspetti's
father, says that someone
has been sneaking into his
house for some reason.
Now, why would you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
布鲁斯佩蒂的父亲，申达尔先生，
说有人因为某种原因潜入他的家。
那你为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You recognized
Bruspetti's diary
pretty quickly...
And you did mention
you were looking for it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你认出蓝色的日记本
好快啊...
而且你刚才还说
你在找它。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Hmpf! S-stop
talking crazy talk!
I don't know what
you're talking about!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
哼！别...别胡说八道！
我不知道你在说什么！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know, I found out
that Bruspetti was planning
on going to Lighthalzen.
It seems that she needed
to learn something really
important over there...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗，我查到了
布鲁斯佩蒂打算去里希塔乐镇。
看来她在那里
需要学习一些非常重要的东西...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
No...!
She couldn't have...!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
不...！
她不可能...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright. It's no use
pretending that you don't
know her. You were her
boyfriend, weren't you?
What would she be trying
to find in Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。装不认识她
是没用的。你是她
的男朋友，对吧？
她想在里希塔乐镇
找什么？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
No! No no no!
Shut up! Shut up!
Please! Just leave
me alone! Get away
from me right now!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒尔]
不！不不不！
闭嘴！闭嘴！
求你了！别缠着我！
现在立刻离我远点！

scripts.text: Mr. Shendar's House
scripts.translation: 申达尔先生的家

scripts.text: Freya's Spring
scripts.translation: 芙蕾雅之泉

scripts.text: Recent Break-up
scripts.translation: 最近分手

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So while she was away
in Lighthalzen, you snuck
in Mr. Shendar's house and--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以趁她去里希塔乐镇
的时候，你溜进了

without her around. It's a little
weird to be talking about this,
but Bruspetti always did smell
nice, just like her mother.
scripts.translation:
[申达尔先生]
我想我女儿了。是的，
没有她在，家里的味道都不一样了。
说这些有点奇怪，
但布鲁斯佩蒂身上总是
很香，就像她母亲一样。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Even if they didn't wear
perfume, they had this
distinctively pleasant
scent about them. I guess
it must be pheremonal?
scripts.translation:
[申达尔先生]
即使她们没喷香水，
身上也有种独特的
宜人气味。我想
那一定是费洛蒙？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Take my advice: never
have a daughter! You worry
too much about them, and they
neglect their parents once
they grow up! I bet she's
having a grand old time...
scripts.translation:
[申达尔先生]
听我的劝：千万别
生女儿！你会为她们
担心太多，而她们长大后
就会忽略父母！我敢打赌
她现在正玩得开心...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Confound it...!
Whoever that guy is,
he better not try any funny
business! As her father, I have
the legal right to wring his
little neck! At least, I should...
scripts.translation:
[申达尔先生]
该死...！
不管那个家伙是谁，
他最好别耍什么花样！
作为她的父亲，我有
合法权利拧断他的脖子！
至少，我应该...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
I just found out that
my precious daughter has
been going out with someone.
She went to some other town
for this boy, and I haven't
heard a word from her since!
scripts.translation:
[申达尔先生]
我刚发现我珍贵的女儿
在和某人交往。
她去了另一个城镇
为了那个男孩，从那以后
我就没收到她的消息！

她现在正玩得开心...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Probably on some lovey
dovey trip with whoever that
boy is. She's been gone an
awful long time, but she's
also an adult now. I... I guess
she should be just fine.
scripts.translation:
[申达尔先生]
大概是在和那个男孩
度蜜月吧。她离开很久了，
但她现在也是大人了。
我...我想她应该没事。

heard a word from her since!

见那个男孩，从那以后

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
If you happen to see
Bruspetti, tell her to
come talk to me. I need
to know whether I figured
out who her boyfriend is!
I can't wait to see her~
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
如果你碰巧见到布鲁斯佩蒂，
请告诉她来找我谈谈。
我需要知道是否猜对了
她男朋友的身份！
我迫不及待想见她~

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Oh, hello again~
Is there any way I can
help you this time? I know
you're looking for Bruspetti,
so I'll help you if you have
any questions for me~
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
噢，又见面了~
这次有什么我能帮你的吗？
我知道你在找布鲁斯佩蒂，
所以如果你有任何问题
都可以问我~

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Lighthalzen? Oh, that's
right! Bruspetti did ask
me about Lighthalzen a while
ago. Yes, she seemed really
interested in learning more
about that place recently.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
里希塔乐镇？噢，对了！
布鲁斯佩蒂之前确实
问过关于里希塔乐镇的事。
是的，她最近似乎对
那个地方很感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Freya's Spring?
Oh, I like that place!
Speaking of which, I know
someone named Katinshuell
that went there pretty often.
Usually men don't go alone...
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
芙蕾雅之泉？
噢，我喜欢那个地方！
说起来，我认识一个叫卡廷舒尔的人，
他经常去那里。
通常男生不会一个人去那里...

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Wait, that's the place
I told you about, where
Bruspetti and her boyfriend
usually met. Do you think
she and Katinshuell...?
Ooh, maybe I figured it out!
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
等等，那是我之前告诉你的地方，
布鲁斯佩蒂和她男朋友通常在那里见面。
你觉得她跟卡廷舒尔...
噢，也许我猜对了！

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
But yeah, that place is
usually filled with couples,
so you look like a real loser
if you go there alone. That's
why I want a boyfriend now...
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
不过那里通常都是情侣，
如果你一个人去，看起来会很可怜。
所以我现在想要一个男朋友...

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Oh, I'm sorry...
I don't know anything
about {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
噢，对不起...
我不认识{0}。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Well, I don't know if
you learned anything
important from me,
but I hope I helped
you, even if it was
just a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
嗯，我不知道你是否从我这里
学到了什么重要的事，
但希望我帮到了你，
哪怕只是一点点也好。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Let's see... Bruspetti
and her guy would usually
meet at... Um, I know where
it is by feel, but I can't really
give you good directions
to get there. Er, sorry!
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
让我想想...布鲁斯佩蒂
和她男朋友通常会在...嗯，
我凭感觉知道在哪里，
但我真的没法给你指路。
呃，抱歉！

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Luckily, this town
isn't that big, so I'm
sure you'll find something
if you just keep looking.
Oh, and if you find her,
tell her I said ''hi,'' okay?
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
幸好这个城镇不大，
只要你一直找，肯定能找到的。
噢，如果你见到她，
替我跟她说声“嗨”，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Oh, Bruspetti's dad
was talking about how
good she smells? Yeah,
she's kinda famous for
that around here, so he's
not creepy or anything.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
噢，布鲁斯佩蒂的爸爸
在说她身上的香味？是的，
她在这方面在当地挺有名的，
所以他不是变态之类的。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
I see, so you think you
caught wind of her in some
other town. Yeah, I heard
that she went traveling to see
if she could learn something,
and she hasn't returned yet.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
原来如此，所以你觉得你在
其他城镇闻到了她的气息。
是的，我听说她出去旅行了，
想看看能不能学到点什么，
她还没回来。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Oh, you know what?
If she's in Lighthalzen,
she's probably gone there to
learn more about her boyfriend.
Bruspetti mentioned something
about that when I last saw her.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
噢，你知道吗？
如果她在里希塔乐镇，
她可能是去那里了解她男朋友的。
上次见到她时，布鲁斯佩蒂
提到了这件事。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
I don't know anything
else. Hmm, maybe if you
check the place where she
and her boyfriend usually
went on dates, you might
be able to find something.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
我不知道其他的事了。嗯，
也许如果你去她和男朋友
通常约会的地方看看，
你可能会找到一些线索。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Ooh, I'm so jealous
of Bruspetti! She's been
spending so much time with
her new boyfriend recently...
But she still refuses to tell
me what his name is.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
噢，我好嫉妒布鲁斯佩蒂！
她最近花了很多时间和
她的新男朋友在一起...
但她还是不肯告诉我
他的名字。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
She told me that she's
serious about him, but
she's also admitted that
she doesn't know much about
him. Let's see... He grew up in Lighthalzen? That's all she knows.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
她告诉我她很认真，
但也承认对他了解不多。
让我想想...他在里希塔乐镇长大？
这是她唯一知道的。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
My friend Bruspetti
is a really nice girl~
Everyone loves her, and
she's sooo beautiful. All
the guys are jealous of
her new boyfriend!
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
我的朋友布鲁斯佩蒂
是个非常好的女孩~
大家都喜欢她，
她超级漂亮。所有的男生
都嫉妒她的新男朋友！

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Still, she's really
shy, and won't tell me
who he is. There's a lot
I don't know about him, but
I'm sure they're happy together.
scripts.translation:
[拉谢伦]
不过，她真的很害羞，
不肯告诉我他是谁。关于他
我有很多不知道的，
但我相信他们在一起很幸福。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey, have you seen
Bruspetti? She's really
nice and always buys me
lots and lots of cookies!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿，你见过布鲁斯佩蒂吗？
她人很好，总是给我买
很多很多饼干！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hmm, I haven't seen
her in a while, though.
I heard she went traveling
somewhere. How long do
you think she'll be gone, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯，我有一段时间没见到她了。
我听说她去哪里旅行了。
你觉得她会离开多久呢？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh wow! I wanna be an
adventurer like you when
I grow up! Go to all sorts
of places, visit different
towns. It sounds so fun!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
噢哇！我长大后想成为
像你一样的冒险者！
去各种各样的地方，
参观不同的城镇。听起来好有趣！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Maybe if I find a really
nice place, maybe I'll just
stay and then move there.
There's somewhere here
that did that, and moved
from Lighthalzen to here~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
也许如果我找到一个
非常好的地方，我就会留下来
然后搬过去。这里有个地方
就是这样做的，从里希塔乐镇搬到了这里~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Yeah, as soon as I get
a chance, I'm gonna ditch
this town and see as much
of the world as I can! I need
to grow up faster than this!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
是的，一旦有机会，
我就要离开这个城镇，
去看看这个世界！我需要
快点长大才行！

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
When you get to be my
age, you'll cherish all
of your memories, even if
the experience was hurtful
when it actually happened.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
等你到了我这个年纪，
你就会珍惜所有的回忆，
哪怕当时经历的是痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Your memories are part
of who you are and what
makes you unique. I can
appreciate living the life
that I have, even if it's
not particularly special.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
回忆是你的一部分，
也是让你与众不同的原因。
我很感激自己拥有的生活，
即使它并不特别。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
When you get to be my
age, you appreciate life
more and can release your
regrets more easily. I wasted
much of my youth in needless
worry when I could've relaxed.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
到了我这个年纪，
你会更懂得珍惜生活，
也更容易放下遗憾。
我年轻时浪费了很多时间
在无谓的担忧上，
本可以放松一下的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, back again, eh?
I guess you must really
like coming to this place
too. Hm, that reminds me...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
噢，又回来了啊？
看来你真的很喜欢
来这个地方呢。嗯，这让我想起...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
See the edge of the spring?
The same young man frequently
comes to that spot, and stares
into the water, just dripping with sadness. Someone so young
shouldn't be feeling like that.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你看泉水的边缘吗？
经常有个年轻男子
来到那里，盯着水面看，
满脸都是悲伤。
这么年轻的人
不该有那样的神情。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
You're supposed to come
here to relax and enjoy
the surrounding beauty,
not wallow in your sorrow.
I guess that boy doesn't
agree with me on that.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你来这里应该是为了
放松身心，欣赏美景，
而不是沉浸在悲伤里。
我想那个男孩
并不认同我的看法。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
You should be able
to let go of whatever's
bothering you, and just
enjoy life as it is now.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你应该能放下
那些困扰你的事情，
好好享受当下的生活。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
I love this place,
its beautiful scenary
and serene atmosphere.
It's so heavenly peaceful.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我爱这个地方，
它美丽的景色
和宁静的氛围。
真是如天堂般安详。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
It brings my heart joy to see
young couples can coming
here and relaxing together.
Isn't love a grand thing?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
看到年轻的情侣
来这里一起放松，
我心里充满了喜悦。
爱情真是美好的事物啊？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This...
This smell...
It smells so nice!
Like rose petals riding
on a gentle breeze...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这...
这股气味...
闻起来好香！
就像玫瑰花瓣
乘着微风飘来...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, could this be
the scent that Bruspetti's
father mentioned earlier?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，这难道是
布鲁斯佩蒂的父亲
之前提到的气味吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just looking at this
spring makes me think
of Bruspetti. What really
happened to her? I get
the feeling that she
caved in to despair.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
光是看着这泉水
就让我想起布鲁斯佩蒂。
她到底发生了什么？
我感觉她
是被绝望吞没了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The water's not that
cold, or very deep...
And Katinshuell mentioned
that her body went limp...
But she was still looking
at him. It's haunting...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
水并不冷，
也不深...
卡廷舒尔说
她的身体变得僵硬...
但她当时还在看着他。
这太令人毛骨悚然了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I suppose she was torn...
She loved him, but couldn't
bear to live with his secret.
In the end, it's all so very
tragic. Katinshuell isn't
really a bad person...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想她当时很痛苦...
她爱他，
却无法忍受带着他的秘密活下去。
到头来，一切都
太悲剧了。卡廷舒尔
并不是一个坏人...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He was forced to
commit a heinous crime,
and kept making mistakes,
running from his guilt. Is
anyone accountable for this?
Who would be to blame?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他被迫犯下了
滔天罪行，
之后又不断犯错，
逃避自己的罪责。
这一切该由谁负责？
该责怪谁呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Somehow, I wish that
Katinshuell had the
strength to face his
guilt, and then to
forgive himself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知为何，我希望
卡廷舒尔能有勇气
面对自己的罪责，
然后原谅自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This must be where
Bruspetti drowned...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里应该就是
布鲁斯佩蒂溺亡的地方...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh! Excuse me,
young adventurer,
but you mustn't stand
there! It's very slippery.
What if you fall into the
spring? It's dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
噢！抱歉，
年轻的冒险者，
你不可以站在这里！
这里很滑。
万一你掉进泉水里怎么办？
很危险的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Er, thank you.
Yes, I wouldn't want
to get myself drowned.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢...呃，谢谢。
是的，我可不想
把自己淹死。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Drowned...? I just
wouldn't want you to
get your clothes wet.
The water isn't that deep...
Even if you can't swim, you
can climb out, you know.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
淹死...？我只是
不想你弄湿衣服而已。
水并不深...
即使你不会游泳，
你也可以爬出来的，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That old woman told
be to be careful not to
slip and fall into the water
around here, so I'd better
make sure I tread carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
刚才那位老奶奶告诉我，
要小心脚下，别滑倒掉进水里。
所以我最好还是小心点走。

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, be very careful!
You don't want to get
too close to the water.
What if you slip and fall?
scripts.translation:
[???]
噢，请非常小心！
你不想离水太近吧。
万一滑倒掉下去怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, I'm sorry if
I startled you, but the
ground that you're standing
on is very slippery, you know.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
噢，抱歉吓到你了，
但你站的地方非常滑，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, I see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，我明白了。

scripts.translation:

^3355FFThis must be

would make you feel
like a real creep.

但是...读它的话，
你会觉得自己像个变态。
所以别碰它。^000000

[Urstialla]

from the outside? Praise be
to Freya! Her love and grace
reaches all over the world,
touching even the hearts of
foreigners, leading them here!
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！

[乌尔斯蒂拉]

遍及全世界，
甚至触动了异乡人的心，
引领他们来到这里！

[Urstialla]

[乌尔斯蒂拉]
愿弗蕾雅永远
以她无尽的恩典与智慧
保护和指引你。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Oh, are you an adventurer
from the outside? Praise be
to Freya! Her love and grace
reaches all over the world,
touching even the hearts of
foreigners, leading them here!
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
噢，你是外来的冒险者吗？
赞美弗蕾雅！她的爱与恩典
遍及全世界，
甚至触动了异乡人的心，
引领他们来到这里！

scripts.text: Freya? I'd like to know more.
scripts.translation: 弗蕾雅？我想多了解一些。

scripts.text: That's crazy talk!
scripts.translation: 这太疯狂了！

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
The day is coming when
Freya will resurrect and
lead all of her faithful to
Valhalla. Now she is in a
deep sleep, but even then,
she watches over all of us.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
那一天终将到来，
弗蕾雅将复活，
带领所有忠实的信徒
前往瓦尔哈拉。现在她正在
沉睡，但即便如此，
她也在守护着我们所有人。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
You see, Freya used up
all of her power fighting the
most fearsome of demons
in the Thousand Year War.
Now she rests and recovers
in a pure and sacred place.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
你看，弗蕾雅在千年战争中
耗尽了所有力量，
与最可怕的恶魔战斗。
现在她在一个纯净神圣的地方
休息和恢复。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
How do you
know that all of
this happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
你怎么知道
这一切都发生过？

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
These are truths that all
of Freya's worshippers know.
Freya delivers her messages to
us through her mortal vessel,
our beautiful pope that shines
with brilliant white light.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
这些都是所有弗蕾雅信徒
都知道的真理。
弗蕾雅通过她的凡间容器
向我们传达信息，
那就是我们美丽的教皇，
她闪耀着耀眼的白光。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Unfortunately, even the most
faithful experience lapses in
judgment. It shames me to
admit that my son Egapeo
is... is guilty of sin.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
不幸的是，即使是最虔诚的信徒
也会犯下判断失误。承认这一点让我感到羞耻，
我的儿子埃加佩奥...是有罪的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sin? What did he
do, if you don't
mind me asking?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
罪？如果不介意的话，
他做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
I don't know, but Egapeo
has been sick for a while
now. I'm convinced that he
did something to anger Freya
Although he may deserve it,
I'm doing my best to help him.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
我不知道，但埃加佩奥
已经病了一段时间了。我确信他
做了一些惹怒弗蕾雅的事。
虽然也许他罪有应得，
但我正在尽力帮助他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Wait. What?!

[Urstialla]
I know that if I pray hard
enough and please Freya,
she will forgive my son and
heal him of his illness.
But sometimes prayer isn't
enough... I need to pay tribute.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
我知道，如果我祈祷得足够虔诚
并取悦弗蕾雅，
她会原谅我的儿子，
并治愈他的疾病。
但有时候祈祷是不够的...
我需要献上祭品。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
I managed to acquire a
necklace of incomparable
beauty from the dwarves.
However, the gems have dulled
with age and need to be shined
before I can offer them to Freya.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
我设法从矮人那里得到了一条
无与伦比的美丽项链。
然而，宝石因年代久远而黯淡，
在我将其献给弗蕾雅之前，
需要重新擦亮。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
However, not just anyone can
shine this special necklace
forged by the Dwarves. I need
someone that knows arcane magic
to help me. I think there's only
one mage that can polish this...
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
然而，并非任何人都能擦亮
这条由矮人打造的特殊项链。
我需要一位精通奥术魔法的人
来帮我。我想只有
一位魔法师能打磨这个...

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Maheo, the renown mage with
access to the most powerful
magic spells in the world,
must be able to clean this
necklace's gems! However
There's no way I can reach him.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
马赫奥，这位拥有世界上最强大
魔法咒语的著名魔法师，
一定能够清洁这条项链的宝石！
但是
我没办法联系到他。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
You see, Maheo left on a
journey to subjugate the
ice monsters in the ice cave
to the north, and he hasn't
returned yet. That place is too
dangerous for people like me.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
你看，马赫奥出发去
征服北方冰洞里的冰系魔物，
至今未归。那个地方对像我这样的人
来说太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
I know that you adventurers
regularly travel through those
kinds of areas, so would you
please look for Maheo and ask
him to clean this necklace on
my behalf? Please, for my son...
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
我知道你们冒险者
经常穿越那些区域，所以请
帮我寻找马赫奥，并请求他
代我清洁这条项链好吗？拜托了，为了我的儿子...

scripts.text: But that's none of my business!
scripts.translation: 但这与我无关！

scripts.text: Alright, I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我答应。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
I... I see.
I thought that Freya
had led you to me, but
maybe my prayers haven't
been answered yet. Perhaps
I need to pray more fervently?.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
我...我明白了。
我以为弗蕾雅指引你来到我面前，
但也许我的祈祷还没有得到回应。
也许我需要更虔诚地祈祷？

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Thank you so much!
Please, take care of this
necklace and ask Maheo
to restore its luster. Then,
it'll be a fitting tribute to
our loving goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
非常感谢！
请保管好这条项链，并请求马赫奥
恢复它的光泽。然后，
它将是对我们慈爱的女神弗蕾雅
最合适的祭品。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
...............................
Are you telling me
that you don't believe?
Repent, and may your
heart be opened to Freya!
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
...............................
你是在告诉我
你不相信吗？
忏悔吧，愿你的心
向弗蕾雅敞开！

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Please find Maheo the
Mage and ask him to restore
the beauty of the necklace
I gave you. He should be
fighting monsters in the
ice cave to the north.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
请找到魔法师马赫奥，
并请求他恢复我给你的
项链的美丽。他应该正在
北方的冰洞里与魔物战斗。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Oh! My necklace! Thank you!
It's so beautiful! It will
make a wonderful tribute to
Freya! I am certain with this,
my son will get better!
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
哦！我的项链！谢谢你！
它太美了！这将是对弗蕾雅
最棒的祭品！我相信有了这个，
我的儿子就会好起来的！

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Here, I know it's not much,
but please accept this as a
token of my appreication for
 what you have done for me.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
拿着，我知道这不算什么，
但请收下这个，作为我对你
为我所做之事的感激之情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, let's just say it was
a worthwhile experience
for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，让我们说这对
我是一次有价值的经历吧。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
.........
............
May Freya always protect and
guide you and forgive you for
that horrible joke.
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
.........
............
愿弗蕾雅永远保护并指引你，
并原谅你那个可怕的玩笑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, no! The necklace has disappeared!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，不！项链不见了！

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
May Freya always
protect and guide you
with her everflowing
grace and wisdom..
scripts.translation:
[乌尔斯蒂拉]
愿弗蕾雅永远以她无尽的
恩典与智慧，
保护并指引你。

scripts.text:
[Man Stuck in Ice]
H-hello?
Hey! Hey, you!
Help me break this
ice! I need to get
out of here!
scripts.translation:
[困在冰中的男子]
你...你好？
嘿！嘿，你！
帮我把这冰敲碎！
我得从这里出去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did you get
stuck in there?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是怎么被
困在那里的？

scripts.text:
[Man Stuck in Ice]
I'll explain everything
later! Just... Just get
this ice off of me!.
scripts.translation:
[困在冰中的男子]
我待会儿再解释！
快...快帮我把
这冰弄掉！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cast Fire Bolt at
the ice..^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你对冰块施放了火箭术。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hammer at the
ice with all your might.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你使出全力敲打冰块。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't...
I can't even scratch it
Do you have any ideas?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我做不到...
我连一点痕迹都抓不出来。
你有什么办法吗？

scripts.text:
[Man Stuck in Ice]
This is so humiliating...
Me, the greatest mage
of our age, Maheo, stuck
in this pillar of ice.
scripts.translation:
[困在冰中的男子]
这太丢人了...
像我这样，我们时代
最伟大的魔法师，马赫奥，
竟然被困在这根冰柱里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
You're Maheo?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
你是马赫奥？

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
It's true. You're speaking to
Maheo, the greatest mage,
and master of arcane spells.
I know magic that even High
Wizards can never hope to
learn in their lifetimes!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
千真万确。你正在与
最伟大的魔法师、
奥术法术的大师马赫奥对话。
我掌握的魔法，
连高阶巫师穷尽一生
也无法学会！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Despite my greatness,
I'm a humble man. See?
That's why I always wear
this Mage uniform...
To remind myself of
the value of humility.
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
尽管我如此伟大，
但我依然谦逊。看？
所以我总是穿着
这身法师制服...
时刻提醒我
谦逊的可贵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So how did you get
stuck in all of this ice?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你到底是怎么
被这些冰困住的？

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Actually, this happened
because I was too humble
You see, I underestimated
myself, and the devastating
force of my own magic.
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
其实，这都怪我太谦逊了。
你看，我低估了自己，
也低估了我自身魔法
那毁灭性的力量。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Yes, this wouldn't have
happened if I wasn't so
humble... Humble and kind.
It all started when I thought
of this cave and how people
sometimes come here to get ice.
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
没错，如果我不那么谦逊...
谦逊且善良，
这一切就不会发生。
事情是这样的，我想到
这个洞穴，人们有时会
来这里取冰。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
I then decided that
I would exterminate these
evil monsters for the good
of the people! The citizens
would feel protected, and
I'd be recognized as a hero!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
于是我决定，
为了人民的福祉，
消灭这些邪恶的魔物！
市民们会感到安全，
我也会被承认为英雄！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay... I suppose
that sounds normal
enough. Go on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧...我觉得
这听起来还算正常。
继续说。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
I valiantly battled
the Snowiers. They were
no match for my magic!
And so, I decided to just
destroy all of them with
one cast of a magic spell.
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
我英勇地与雪怪战斗。
它们根本不是我的对手！
于是，我决定用
一次魔法施放
将它们全部消灭。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
You know Meteor Storm?
I know another spell like
that... But it's two hundred
times more powerful! Yes...
It has the power of a million
exploding suns! But then...
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
你知道陨石术吗？
我知道另一个类似的法术...
但它的威力是它的两百倍！
是的...
它拥有一百万个爆炸太阳的力量！
但是然后...

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
It was too powerful!
There were tremors, and
flying shards of ice, and
all the flame caused my
clothes to catch on fire!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
威力太强了！
地面在震动，
冰屑四处飞溅，
而且火焰让我的
衣服都着火了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You...
you set fire
to your clothes
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...
你把你的衣服
点着了

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Yes, but not to worry.
I quickly extinguished
those flames with my
powerful Frost Diver spell!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
是的，但别担心。
我迅速用我强大的
冰锥术熄灭了
那些火焰！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
In hindsight...
That may have
been a mistake...
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
回想起来...
那可能
是个错误...

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Enough about myself.
What noble pursuit brings
you to this place, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
别听我啰嗦了。
是什么高贵的追求
把你带到这个地方，冒险者？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that you can
polish the gems on this
necklace with your magic,
so I came here to find you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说你可以
用魔法打磨这条项链上的
宝石，
所以我来这里找你。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Verily, I can shine
those gems so that they
shine as brightly as a
million exploding suns!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
诚然，我可以
让那些宝石闪耀，
让它们像一百万个
爆炸的太阳一样明亮！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
That is, as soon
as I can get out
of this ice. Hmm...
But I doubt normal
magic will be able
to melt all of this.
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
也就是说，只要
我能从这冰里
出来。嗯...
但我怀疑普通的
魔法能融化
这么多冰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then how are we
supposed to get
you out of there?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我们该怎么
把你从那里
弄出来呢？

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Fear not. I'm sure
that my master will know
of a way to free me from
this prison of ice. He can
be found near Freya's Spring:
beseech him on my behalf!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
别怕。我相信
我的师父会知道
如何让我摆脱
这座冰牢。他可以在
芙蕾雅之泉附近找到：
请代我向他求助！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
My master may not have
my sheer talent, but he
is very knowledgable in
the ways of magic. Please...
Ask him for help. He should
be reading near Freya's Spring.
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
我的师父可能没有
我那么大的天赋，
但他对魔法之道
非常博学。请...
向他求助。他应该
在芙蕾雅之泉附近读书。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Oh, you're back!
So did my master have
any ideas on breaking
this cold prison of ice?
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
哦，你回来了！
那么我的师父有没有
什么主意能打破
这座冰冷的冰牢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, shoot! I left the necklace in the city! I will be right back!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀！我把项链忘在城市里了！我马上回来！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Hey, hey! Can't you just release me first?
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
嘿，嘿！你不能先
把我放出来吗？

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
My master may not have
my sheer talent, but he
is very knowledgable in
the ways of magic. Please...
Ask him for help. He should
be reading near Freya's Spring.
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
我的师父可能没有
我那么大的天赋，
但他对魔法之道
非常博学。请...
向他求助。他应该
在芙蕾雅之泉附近读书。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, he made this
magic hammer which is
supposed to be able to
break this magic ice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，他做了这把
魔法锤子，据说
能打破这魔法冰。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Of course!
Why didn't I think of
that? Great, now get
me out of here please!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
当然！
我怎么没想到呢？
太好了，现在请
把我弄出来！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tightly gripped
the Wind Hammer, and
swung it down at the ice
with all of your strength.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你紧紧握住
风之钢斧，
用尽全力挥向
冰块。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Pzzzzz*
*CRASH!*^000000

[Maheo]
Finally...!
After all of this
time! I'm free!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
终于...！
经历了这么长时间！
我自由了！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Now, all of the monsters
in this cave will taste the
wrath of the greatest mage in
the world! I'll have my revenge,
and give those beasts double
the pain that they gave me!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
现在，这个洞穴里的
所有魔物都将品尝
世界最强魔法师的
怒火！我要复仇，
让那些野兽承受
比它们给我两倍
的痛苦！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Muhahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Er, but first, I need to
use my magic to clean
that necklace of yours.
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
呃，不过首先，
我需要用法术
清理一下你的项链。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Oh! This was made by
the Dwarves, wasn't it?
It looks like they've made
yet another masterpiece.
Shame that this is so
tarnished, though.
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
哦！这是矮人
制作的吧？
看起来他们又
打造了一件杰作。
可惜它变得
这么脏兮兮的。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Let's see, now...
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Well, I suppose this
is where we part ways.
Here, take this as a gift...
And please don't mention
the fact that I trapped myself
in ice to anyone else, okay?
scripts.translation:
[马赫奥]
好了，我想
我们该分别了。
拿着，这是给你的礼物...
还有，请千万不要告诉别人
我把自己冻在冰里的事，好吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Hm? Did you need
something? If it's not too
important, then I'd like to
get back to reading my book.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
嗯？你需要什么吗？
如果不重要的话，
我想继续看书。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Hm? Did you need
something? If it's not too
important, then I'd like to
get back to reading my book.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
嗯？你需要什么吗？
如果不重要的话，
我想继续看书。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, would you know
a mage by the name
of Maheo? I'm supposed
to go look for his master
around this area.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请问，您认识
一位名叫马赫奥的魔法师吗？
我听说要去这一带
寻找他的师父。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Well, you've found him
because that would be me.
What happened to Maheo?
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
既然你找到了我，
那我就是他的师父。
马赫奥怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
He froze himself?!
Hahahaha! Some genius!
Oh, well, I suppose he still
has plenty to learn about
character, if not magic.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
他把自己冻住了？！
哈哈哈！真是个天才！
唉，看来他在性格方面
还有很多要学的，
虽然魔法方面可能已经不错了。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Let's see, let's see...
This book ought to have
the answer. Mmm... Ah!
Page 42! I need to construct
an artifact in order to break
that mystical ice. Mmm.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
让我想想...
这本书里应该有答案。
嗯...啊！
第42页！我需要制造一件
神器才能打破那层魔法之冰。
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Would you help
me? I need to get
^4D4DFF5 Rough Winds^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Hammer^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Blank Scroll^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
你能帮我吗？
我需要
^4D4DFF5风灵原石^000000、
^4D4DFF1锤子^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1空卷轴^000000

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
You can get Blank Scrolls
in the Sage Academy in Juno.
Ah, and the Hammer is a weapon,
not one of those smithing tools.
I'd help you if I could, but...
I'm just smart, not strong.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
你可以在朱诺的贤者学院
买到空卷轴。
啊，还有，锤子是武器，
不是那种锻造工具。
如果我能帮忙就好了，但是...
我只是聪明，并不强壮。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
I need to create
a magical artifact
to break the ice that's
trapping Maheo. Would you
please help me? There's no
way I can get the items myself!
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
我需要制造一件
魔法神器来打破
困住马赫奥的冰。
请帮帮我吧！
我自己绝对拿不到那些材料！

scripts.text:

I need to get

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Great, you have everything
I need! But first, would you
make sure that you only have
1 Hammer in your inventory?
If you have more than one,
I might take the wrong Hammer.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
太好了，你集齐了
我需要的东西！
不过首先，请确认
你的物品栏里只有一把锤子？
如果你有多把，
我可能会拿错。

scripts.text: Let me check.
scripts.translation: 让我检查一下

scripts.text: Don't worry, I checked.
scripts.translation: 别担心，我检查过了

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Alright, it's always
better to be safe than
sorry! If only Maheo was
a little more careful, more
like you are, then maybe this
wouldn't have happened.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
好的，小心驶得万年船！
如果马赫奥能像你一样
稍微小心一点，
也许就不会发生这种事了。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Okay, I'll take your
word for it. Now, let's
bring the artifact forging
process. Hmmm... Let me
review it here on page 45.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
好的，我相信你。
那么，让我们开始
锻造神器吧。
嗯...让我翻到第45页
确认一下流程。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Here we go...!
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
找到了...！

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
...Aaaand now it's done.
Here, take this Wind Hammer
and use it to free Maheo.
This hammer will only work
once, so make sure that you
smash that ice properly!
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
...完成了。
拿着这把风之钢斧，
去解救马赫奥吧。
这把锤子只能使用一次，
所以一定要确保
能顺利砸碎那层冰！

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
There are always
singing birds and
flitting butterflies
all over this place
It's so relaxing, and
such a great place to read.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
这里到处都有
歌唱的鸟儿和
飞舞的蝴蝶。
这里非常令人放松，
是个读书的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
I work at the bar around
here, and I've heard good
things about you. Some of
the customers've heard that
you helped Urstialla by going
into that dangerous Ice Cave.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
我就在这附近的酒吧工作，
听说你名声不错。有些
顾客听说你为了帮助
乌尔斯蒂拉，闯入了
那个危险的冰洞。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Now, are you really capable
of regularly defeating the
snow monsters inside there?
If you are, I've got a bit of a
business proposition for you.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
那么，你真的有能力
定期击败里面的
雪怪吗？
如果是的话，
我有一个小小的商业
提议想跟你谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
The weather around here
is naturally hot and humid,
so we need ice to make cold,
refreshing drinks at the pub.
And the Ice Cave is the best
place to get that ice, right?
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
这里的天气
天然炎热潮湿，
所以我们需要冰来
在酒吧制作冰镇
清爽的饮料。
而冰洞正是获取
冰块的最佳地点，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
If you bring me Ice Pieces
from the Ice Cave, I'll buy
them from you at 375 zeny
each. Think of it as kind of a
freelance job. I mean, if you
can bring me ice, I'll buy it!.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
如果你能从冰洞
给我带来冰碎片，
我会以每个375 Zeny
的价格收购。你可以
把它看作是一份自由职业。
我是说，如果你能
给我弄来冰，我就买！

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
You can make some good
money, my customers can
enjoy ice cold drinks, and
my business will definitely
benefit. We'd kill three birds
with one stone! What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
你可以赚不少钱，
我的顾客可以享用
冰镇饮料，
我的生意也肯定会
受益。这真是一举三得！
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Aww, how disappointing.
I was really sure that this
would be a great deal for
both of us. Well, if you're
willing to change your mind
then we can be partners!
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
哎呀，真令人失望。
我原本以为这对
我们双方来说
都会是一笔好买卖。
好吧，如果你愿意
改变主意，
我们随时可以合作！

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Great! Now, the ice that
I need comes from Glacial
Hearts. You can obtain those
by hunting the snow monsters
in the Ice Cave. Remember, I'll
pay you 375 zeny for each one!
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
太好了！那么，我需要的
冰来自冰块心脏。
你可以通过猎杀冰洞里的
雪怪来获得它们。
记住，我会以每个
375 Zeny的价格收购！

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Bring me some Glacial
Hearts from the Ice Cave,
and I'll be sure to compensate
you with some zeny. This is a
really good deal for the two
of us when you think about it.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
从冰洞给我带些
冰块心脏来，
我一定会用Zeny
好好补偿你。
仔细想想，这对我们
双方来说都是一笔
非常划算的交易。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Perfect, you brought me
some Glacial Hearts! I can
never get used to the beauty
and purity of these ice crystals.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
完美，你带给我
一些冰块心脏！
我从未习惯过这些
冰结晶的美丽与纯净。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Yes, I think I might
even be able to use these
to make Arunafeltz Glacial
Wine. Anyway, let me see
how many you've brought me.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
是的，我想我甚至
可以用这些来制作
阿鲁纳菲兹冰川酒。
不管怎样，让我看看
你带了多少给我。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
{0} Glacial Hearts
at 375 zeny each...
Looks like I owe you
{1} zeny. Here you are!
It's always a pleasure
doing business with you~
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
{0}个冰块心脏，
每个375 Zeny...
看来我欠你
{1} Zeny。给你！
能与你做生意
总是件乐事~

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Welcome to--
Er? Hello?
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
欢迎光临——
呃？你好？
请问？

scripts.translation: 踢门

scripts.text: Smash Door with Weapon.
scripts.translation: 用武器砸门

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Please don't do that!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
请不要那样做！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Good day, adventurer.
May I ask what brings
you to the temple today?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
日安，冒险者。
请问您今天来神殿有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Just sight-seeing.
scripts.translation: 只是观光

scripts.text: I came to pray.
scripts.translation: 我来祈祷

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I guess most foreigners
aren't familiar with our
faith, so I suppose they
wouldn't come here to pray...
Well, I hope you enjoy your
time here, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
我想大多数外国人不熟悉我们的信仰，所以大概不会来这里祈祷吧...
希望您在这里度过愉快的时光，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh! I'm glad to see that
our kind of spirituality is
practiced in other countries~
You know, we at the Temple of
Cheshrumnir will be hosting a
festival here at the temple.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
哦！很高兴看到我们的信仰在其他国家也有实践~
你知道吗，瑟斯隆尼勒神殿将在这里举办一场节日庆典。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
We're accepting donations
for the festival, so we'd be
grateful if you could make
a contribution. Regardless,
we invite you to celebrate the
grace of the goddess with us.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
我们正在为节日庆典接受捐赠，如果您能慷慨解囊，我们将不胜感激。无论如何，我们邀请您与我们一起庆祝女神的恩典。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
There's one High Priest that
disagrees with collecting money
from the temple's patrons, but
it's up to you if you want to
give or not. If you donate, you
might be able to win a prize!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
有一位神官反对向神殿的信徒收取费用，但捐不捐由您决定。如果您捐赠，也许能赢得奖品！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
You can use our Lottery Tickets
to win something nice from our
Temple Storage. However, you
donate the 50,000 zeny for each
Lottery Ticket, which also happens to be the minimum donation amount.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
您可以使用彩票从神殿仓库中赢取好东西。每张彩票需要捐赠50,000 Zeny，这也是最低捐赠金额。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
The prizes that are given to
donators are also randomly
chosen, so I have no way of
telling you what you'd get.
Would you be interested
in making a donation?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
捐赠者获得的奖品也是随机抽取的，所以我无法告诉您会获得什么。
您有兴趣进行捐赠吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I understand. Well,
maybe some other time.
May Freya bless you on
all your journeys. May the
grace of the goddess always
support us in all that we do~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
我理解。那么，也许下次吧。
愿弗蕾雅祝福您所有的旅程。愿女神的恩典始终支持我们的一切~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Great! How much would you
like to donate? We can only
accept donations in increments
of 50,000 zeny, and we can only
accept up to 150,000 zeny at once. It's a bit complicated, I know...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
太好了！您想捐赠多少？我们只能接受50,000 Zeny的整数倍捐赠，且一次最多接受150,000 Zeny。我知道这有点复杂...

scripts.text: 50,000z - 1 Lottery Ticket

150,000z - 3 Lottery Ticket
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]

some thought to part with an
amount of money like 50,000
zeny. Even so, Freya is always
protecting you, wherever you go~
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh, you're {0}!
Welcome back! I remember
that you donated just a little
while ago. So what brings you
to the temple today, hmm?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
哦，是{0}！
欢迎回来！我记得您刚才才捐赠过。那么，今天是什么风把您吹到神殿来了呢，嗯？

scripts.text: I've come to donate again.
scripts.translation: 我又来捐赠了。

scripts.text: Just sight-seeing.
scripts.translation: 只是观光

scripts.text: I came to attend the service.
scripts.translation: 我来参加仪式。

scripts.text: I just wanted to see you again.
scripts.translation: 我只是想再来看看您。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
You've come to make another
donation? Splendid! How much
would you like to donate this
time? Remember that we can only
accept donations in increments of
50,000 zeny up to 150,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
您又要来捐赠了吗？太好了！这次您想捐赠多少？请记得我们只能接受50,000 Zeny的整数倍捐赠，且一次最多接受150,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: 50,000z - 1 Lottery Ticket
100,000z - 2 Lottery Ticket
150,000z - 3 Lottery Ticket
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I understand that it takes
some thought to part with an
amount of money like 50,000
zeny. Even so, Freya is always
protecting you, wherever you go~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
我理解拿出50,000 Zeny这样一笔钱需要好好考虑一下。不过，无论您去往何处，芙蕾雅女神都会一直守护着您的~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh! If you'd like some
information about our temple,
why don't you ask Priestess
Pano at the Help Desk inside?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
哦！如果您想了解关于神殿的资讯，不妨去里面的咨询台问问女祭司 帕诺？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Penno will also redeem
your Lottery Tickets for
prizes, although she doesn't
really seem to enjoy that job.
Well, anyway, she'll help
you out. See you later!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
佩诺也会帮您兑换彩票奖品，虽然她看起来不太喜欢这份工作。总之，她会帮您的。再见啦！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
You're here for the
service? That's great~
I hope you find the sense
of calm that you can only
get from goddess Freya~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
您是来参加仪式的吗？太好了~
希望您能感受到只有芙蕾雅女神才能赐予的宁静~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh, how sweet of you~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
哎呀，您真贴心~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Welcome to our temple!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
欢迎来到我们的神殿！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Hello, there!
...............................
Um, for some reason, the
temple gate hasn't opened yet
But it should be open now. Well
this happens sometimes so...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
你好呀！
...............................
嗯，不知为何，神殿的大门还没打开。
但现在应该已经开了才对。这种事偶尔也会发生，所以...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
See, there's this auto locking
system that was added to the
gate when this temple was
built, but now it's more of
an annoyance than security.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
你看，这座神殿建造时，大门上加装了一套自动锁定系统，但现在它带来的麻烦比安全感还多。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Every time someone messes
with the lock, or if it breaks,
we have to wait until it auto
resets itself before it works
again. No one can fix it
really quickly, you know...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
每次有人乱动锁，或者它坏了，我们都得等它自动重置后才能再次使用。没人能很快修好它，你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
^333333*Sniff*^000000 What should I do?
The auto reset never takes
this long, and I really need
to go inside. ^333333*Sob*^000000 P-Panno!
Panno, I neeeed heeeeelp~!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
^333333*吸鼻子*^000000 我该怎么办？
自动重置从来没这么久过，而我真的很想进去。^333333*抽泣*^000000 帕-帕诺！
帕诺，我需-需要帮-帮忙~！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
If the gate's locked, then
I've just got to find that
secret entrance. Some kids
supposedly use it to enter
and play pranks in the temple,
but I don't know who they are...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
如果大门锁了，那我只能去找那个秘密入口了。听说有些小孩用它溜进来在神殿里恶作剧，但我不知道他们是谁...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Panno would know
what to do... I think.
Ooh, Panno, help me!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
帕诺应该知道该怎么办...我想。
哦，帕诺，帮帮我！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh, {0}!
The gate just opened and
I was able to get inside
the temple! ^333333*Whew*^000000 I was
getting really worried
about it for awhile.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
哦，{0}！
大门刚才开了，我成功进神殿了！^333333*呼*^000000 刚才我真的担心了好久。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
This is the first time that the
gate locked up since Panno
was assigned to her post in
the temple. I thought maybe
something happened and
she got in trouble, you know?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
这是帕诺被分配到神殿岗位以来，大门第一次锁住。我还以为发生了什么事，她是不是遇到麻烦了，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Wait, wait...
I'm outside. What if
the gate locks up again?
Oooh, what should I do?!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
等等，等等...
我在外面。万一大门又锁了怎么办？
哎呀，我该怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Hey, {0}~!
We reached our target!
Isn't that great? We're no
longer asking for donations,
but you can still redeem your
Lottery Tickets inside, okay?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
嘿，{0}~！
我们达成目标了！
真棒，对吧？我们不再接受捐款了，
不过你仍然可以在里面兑换彩票哦。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Mmm... I know what
I can do! I can ask for
Firecrackers! Yes, that'll
be fun for the festival.
Hey, do you know where
those things are sold?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
嗯...我知道可以做什么了！
我可以要一些爆竹！
是的，节日里放爆竹会很有趣。
嘿，你知道哪里卖那些东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I, uh, can't give you
much... But if you would
bring me some Firecrackers,
then I'll pray for your good
fortune. Sorry, but that's
all I can really offer.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
我...我没法给你太多...
但如果你能给我一些爆竹，
我会为你祈祷好运。
抱歉，我只能提供这些。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Hey, bring me
a lot of Firecrackers,
like, ^FF000020 of them^000000! Thank
you thank you thank you!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
嘿，给我带很多爆竹，
比如，^FF000020个^000000！
谢谢谢谢谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Hey, did you bring me
^FF000020 Firecrackers^000000? Mmm?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
嘿，你带了^FF000020个爆竹^000000给我吗？嗯？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 不，还没准备好。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Yay!
Firecrackers!
Oh, let me pray
for your good fortune!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
耶！
爆竹！
哦，让我为你祈祷好运！

scripts.text:
^3355FFPriestess Nemma prayed
fervently for your good
fortune. It feels like
it's actually working...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF女祭司 奈玛
虔诚地为你祈祷好运。
感觉真的有用...^000000

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I'm done!
Now it's time
to play! Hm, maybe
our pope would like
to see these too?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
我完成了！
现在该玩了！
嗯，也许我们的教皇
也想看看这些？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Awww...
This isn't enough
Firecrackers. I mean,
I know it's like a donation,
but still. How much fun are
fireworks if there isn't a lot?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
哎呀...
爆竹不够多。
我是说，我知道这像捐款，
但毕竟...如果数量不多，
烟花有什么好玩的？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Awww...
Well, I don't really
have much to pay you
back with, anyway~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
哎呀...
反正我也没什么能回报你的~

scripts.text:

Welcome to our temple!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
欢迎来到我们的神殿！

So, {0}...

那么，{0}...

你想捐赠{1} Zeny，

don't have enough zeny with
you, then you can just come
back and donate later. Our
goddess Freya smiles on the

scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
哦，我明白了。那么，如果你
身上没有足够的Zeny，
你可以稍后再来捐赠。
我们的女神芙蕾雅
会微笑注视慷慨的人，
并奖励耐心的人！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I can scarcely believe it...
You're carrying so much stuff,
you don't even have enough
room for a Lottery Ticket.
You'd better put some of
your things in Storage, yes?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
我简直不敢相信...
你带了这么多东西，
连放彩票的空间都没有。
你最好把一些东西放进仓库，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Don't worry, I'll still be
here after you make more
space available in your
Inventory. Hurry back, and
donate if you can, okay?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
别担心，等你腾出
更多背包空间后，
我还会在这里。
快点回来，如果能的话就捐赠吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
There you are~
Thanks so much for
your donation! I'm sure
that Freya is smiling down
upon you, and will reward
you for your generosity~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
你来了~
非常感谢你的捐赠！
我相信芙蕾雅
正在微笑着注视你，
并会奖励你的慷慨~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Thank you so much! We'll be
continuing to accept donations
until we reach our target. Once
we receive {0} more donations
in increments of 50,000 zeny,
our fundraiser will finish.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
非常感谢！我们将继续接受捐款，
直到达到目标。一旦我们
再收到{0}笔捐款，
每笔50,000 Zeny，
我们的募捐活动就会结束。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
If you're feeling so
inclined, come back later
and make another contribution.
Thanks again, and may Freya
always watch over you.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈玛]
如果你愿意，稍后再来
做另一笔贡献。
再次感谢，愿芙蕾雅
永远保佑你。

[Priestess Nemma]

less than {0} zeny...

嗯，也许下次吧，好吗？

嘿，看看你的衣服！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Are you from a
different country?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你是从别的国家来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Huh, huh?
What country
are you from?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯？
你来自哪个国家？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Eh, whatever.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊，算了。

[Kid]
Oh hey, do
you like candy?

哦，嘿，

哼！好吧。

[Kid]
Oh. It's 'cause you're

you like candies, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦。是因为你是大人吗？
为什么大人都不喜欢糖果呢？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Why, huh?
Tell me, tell
me, how come?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
为什么啊？
告诉我，告诉我，
到底为什么？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh yeah...?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦，是吗...？

scripts.translation:
[小孩]
不过你是大人，

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Candy is only for
kids! Hahahahaah!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
糖果是小孩子吃的！
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I tricked you!
You big big dummy!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我骗到你了！
你这个大笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh, you do?
Does that mean
that you have
any candy, then?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦，你喜欢？
那意思是你身上
有糖果吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I want one!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我想要一个！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hurry, give me one!
Gimmie gimmie~!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
快点，给我一个！
给我给我~！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Mmm...
If you give me
some Candy, then I'll
tell you something
really cool, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯...
如果你给我一些糖果，
我就告诉你一个
超酷的事情，好不好？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Yay~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
耶~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hah! Got you!
I didn't want any
candy anyway! Nyeh!
But I like you, so
I can tell you a secret!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哈！骗到你了！
我本来就不想要糖果！
哼！
不过我喜欢你，
所以可以告诉你一个秘密！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Did you know that
they always leave one

unlocked? You spy on the
priests inside. They're always

scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你知道吗？
他们总是留一扇
通往神殿的窗户不锁。

这不好吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh well, they're adults,
so I dunno. Maybe they...

fighting is supposed to be bad.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
算了，他们是大人，

嗯。反正我记得
打架是不好的事情。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Awww, nuts!
I just remembered!
If you have candy, it
must be from another
country! I should have
taken it from you. Dang it!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哎呀，糟糕！
我突然想起来！
如果你有糖果，
那一定是从别的国家带来的！
我本该抢过来的。真倒霉！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oooh, I hate you
now! Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
噢，我现在
讨厌你了！
别理我！

[Kid]
You don't wanna

[小孩]
你不想

[Kid]

scripts.translation:
[小孩]
等等，你没有
糖果，是吗？

里装满了糖果！

[Kid]
See?

this candy!

[小孩]
看到了吗？
看看这些
糖果！

[Kid]

have at least this

scripts.translation:
[小孩]
没错，你至少
要有这么多糖果，
才能说你喜欢糖果。
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh hey...
Would you like to
have some candy?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦，对了...
你想吃一点
糖果吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Haha! I tricked you!

all this candy with you!

scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哈哈！我又骗到你了！
我才不会把这些糖果

scripts.text:
[Kid]

at me, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦...
你是在生我的气，
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Okay, okay.
I'll tell you a really
cool secret, so promise
that you won't be mad anymore.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
好啦，好啦。
我会告诉你一个
超酷的秘密，
所以答应我，
不要再生气了。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Kid]

scripts.translation:
[小孩]
拜托~

[Kid]
