fighting! Isn't that bad?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你知道吗？
他们总是留一扇
通往神殿的窗户不锁。
你可以偷看里面的牧师。
他们总是在打架！
这不好吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh well, they're adults,
so I dunno. Maybe they...
Mm. Well, I remember that
fighting is supposed to be bad...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
算了，他们是大人，
所以我不懂。也许他们...
嗯。反正我记得
打架是不好的事情...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Now, I hope you
won't be mad at
me anymore...
If you're not,
then I'm gonna
be madder at you!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
现在，我希望你
不要再生我的气了...
如果你不生气，
那我就要更生气啦！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
You're leaving?
Don't you want to
watch me play Rock,
Paper, Scissors?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你要走了？
你不想看我玩
石头剪刀布吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey! I don't like
the way you're looking
at me. I don't like you
watching me like that!
Why don't you go away?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿！我不喜欢你
看我的眼神。
我不喜欢你
那样盯着我看！
你干嘛不滚开？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Gosh, I said, go away!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
天哪，我说了，
快滚开！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
If you're that bored,
why don't you peep through
the windows in the temple,
huh? Gosh! Some people!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
如果你那么无聊，
干嘛不去神殿的窗户
往里偷看呢？
真是的！有些人啊！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou notice a slightly
open window that
you can easily enter.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你注意到一扇
微微敞开的窗户，
很容易就能进去。^000000

scripts.text: Stay
scripts.translation: 停牌

scripts.text: Enter Through Window
scripts.translation: 从窗户进入

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pull the window,
and it smoothly opens.
This is probably what
those mischevious hits
have been using to enter
unnoticed into this temple.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拉开窗户，
它很顺滑地打开了。
这大概就是那些
调皮捣蛋的家伙
用来神不知鬼不觉地
潜入这座神殿的通道。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide that it's
wrong to sneak into
a place. But what if
you don't get caught?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你决定偷偷潜入
某个地方是不对的。
但如果你没被抓到呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWould you like to
enter the temple
through this window?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你想通过这扇窗户
进入神殿吗？^000000

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFUsing this window is
probably the only way
that you can enter.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF使用这扇窗户
大概是你唯一
能进入的方法。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThis window is open.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这扇窗户是开着的。^000000

scripts.text: Stay
scripts.translation: 停牌

scripts.text: Exit Through Window
scripts.translation: 从窗户离开

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's strangely
dark in here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里莫名地
很昏暗。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear some
noise from the hallway
towards the chapel. It
sounds like there are
several other people here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你听到通往
礼拜堂的走廊里
传来一些声响。
听起来这里
还有其他人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear noises of some
commotion from the stairs.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你听到楼梯那边
传来一阵骚动。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear something
fall from the stairs,
followed by noises that
sound like a scuffle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你听到有什么东西
从楼梯上掉下来，
接着传来像是
扭打的声音。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's a spot on the
ground that's darker than
the rest of the floor...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地面上有一块
比周围地板
更暗的地方...^000000

scripts.text: Investigate
scripts.translation: 调查

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's too dark to
really see the spot^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF太暗了，
看不清那块地方^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt smells a little bit
like copper or iron. Blood
has probably been spilled here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有点
像铜或铁的味道。
这里大概
流了血。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide that your
time would be better spent
investigating something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你决定把时间花在
调查别的事情上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis dark spot on the
ground is really creepy,
no matter how many
times you look at it.^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地面上这块黑斑真的很诡异，
无论看多少次都让人毛骨悚然。^000000

scripts.text: Investigate Again
scripts.translation: 再次调查

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe blood on the ground
hasn't dried up yet, but
it's probably cold by now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上的血还没有干，
但应该已经变凉了吧。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe amount of blood
on the ground is more
than can be contained in just
one person. You'd better get
out of here before it's too late.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上的血量远超一个人的容量。
最好在情况恶化前离开这里。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide that your
time would be better spent
investigating something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你决定把时间花在
调查别的事情上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis blood stain on the
ground is a pretty bad
sign. You might have to
escape this place before
whatever caused this much
bleeding does the same to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上的血迹是个很坏的征兆。
也许你得在造成这种大出血的东西
对你做同样的事之前逃离此地。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
Only the goddess exists.
scripts.translation:
[???]
唯有女神存在。

scripts.text:
[???]
Everyone must be
ready for her coming.
scripts.translation:
[???]
每个人都必须为她的降临做好准备。

scripts.text:
[???]
Izlude, my hometown,
I have come to this
place to build.
scripts.translation:
[???]
依斯鲁得岛，我的家乡，
我来到此地是为了建设它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Th-that's Priestess
Panno's voice! But isn't
she just outside the door?
What exactly was she saying?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那...那是女祭司帕诺的声音！
但她不是就在门外吗？
她刚才到底在说什么？

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe gate is closed.^000000
Push Gate
scripts.translation: 推门

scripts.text: Examine Gate
scripts.translation: 检查大门

scripts.text: Kick Gate
scripts.translation: 踢门

scripts.text: Smash Gate with Weapon
scripts.translation: 用武器砸门

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou push the gate
with all of your might...
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拼尽全力推门...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou push the gate
with all of your might...
But it won't even budge.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拼尽全力推门...
但门纹丝不动。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's some strange
machinery installed on
the gate, and a slot where
it looks you you can insert
a card or permit. The lights
are on, so it must be working.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF门上安装着某种奇怪的机械，
还有一个看起来可以插入卡片或许可证的插槽。
灯亮着，说明它正在运行。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou angrily kick the gate...
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你愤怒地踢门...
