^3355FFYou angrily kick the gate...
But no matter how much rage
you put into your kick, the
gate refuses to open for you.
Oh, and your foot hurts too.^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你愤怒地踢门...
但无论你在踢腿中注入多少怒气，
门都拒绝为你打开。
哦，还有，你的脚很痛。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait! That's not
a good idea. You can't
smash down the gate to
a holy place: heroes don't
specialize in desecration.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等！这不是个好主意。
你不能砸开神圣之地的门：
英雄不擅长亵渎神圣之物。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
For some reason, you look
familiar to me. Are you supposed
to be here? Otherwise, you should
leave this place if you don't have
the proper authorization.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
不知为何，我觉得你有些面熟。
你是应该在这里的人吗？
如果没有得到正式授权，
你应该离开这个地方。

scripts.text: I'm here on Vincent's behalf
scripts.translation: 我是受文森特之托来的

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Vincent sent you? I see.
You must have been looking
for me. I am High Priest Zhed,
and I understand that you
have a package for me.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
是文森特派你来的？我明白了。
你一定是来找我的。
我是大祭司泽德，
我知道你有一件包裹要交给我。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Usually, Vincent doesn't
trust strangers to deliver
these packages, but perhaps
this was necessitated by some
strange circumstance. Anyway,
let's see what he sent me...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
通常，文森特不会信任陌生人
来送这些包裹，但也许
这是由某些特殊情况所迫。
总之，让我们看看他寄了什么...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hm? What's this?
Vincent sent a note?
I suppose this must be
important. Give me just a
moment to read this, please...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
嗯？这是什么？
文森特寄了一张纸条？
我想这一定很重要。
请给我一点时间读一下...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
...............................
...Hrrrmm. Vincent. Now
I understand. So he was being
intentionally cold towards Jenny
and Phoebe so other people
wouldn't get suspicious...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
...............................
...嗯。文森特。
我现在明白了。
原来他故意对珍妮和菲比冷淡，
是为了不让其他人起疑心...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Still, I don't think he
had to do that--it might
have been a little too
much. Well, I really
appreciate your help
in this matter, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
不过，我觉得他不必做到那种地步——
可能有点过头了。
无论如何，非常感谢你
在这件事上对我的帮助，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
But tell me, did you only
help Vincent and risk your
life because you were being
paid? Were you only being
motivated by the money?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
但请告诉我，你帮助文森特
并冒着生命危险，
仅仅是因为拿了报酬吗？
你只是被金钱驱动的吗？

scripts.text: Actually... I was just curious.
scripts.translation: 其实...我只是出于好奇。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You were doing this just to
satisfy your curiosity? Heh
heh, that's very interesting.
That's also the best attitude
for a brave adventurer. I like
that. May I have your name?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
你只是为了满足好奇心才做这些？
呵呵，这很有趣。
这也是勇敢冒险者最好的态度。
我很喜欢。可以告诉我你的名字吗？

scripts.text: Tell him your name.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你的名字。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
{0}...
Yes, that's a fine name.
It suits you well. I'll be sure
to remember that. Again, let
me thank you for risking your
life to retrive my belongings.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
{0}...
是的，这是个不错的名字。
很适合你。我会记住的。
再次感谢你冒着生命危险
取回我的物品。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I shall be praying for
Freya to guide and protect
you in your travels. Peace
be with you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我会祈祷弗蕾雅女神
指引并保护你的旅途。
愿平安与你同在，{0}。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, {0}...
I appreciate that you've
managed to retrieve my
belongings for me. You are
a truly talented adventurer.
May Freya protect you...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，{0}...
我很感激你成功
为我取回了物品。
你是一位真正有才华的冒险者。
愿弗蕾雅保护你...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, good, I was hoping you'd
show up here sooner or later.
I have a favor to ask of you
since I'm too busy to do it
myself, and I trust you more
than any other adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，太好了，我本来希望你能早点来。
因为我太忙了，没法亲自去做，
所以想请你帮个忙，
而且我比信任其他任何冒险者都更信任你。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
However, before I give you
the details, you must know
that this favor must be kept
secret. In other words, once
I explain the task, you must
accept my request.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
不过，在我告诉你细节之前，
你必须知道这个请求必须保密。
换句话说，一旦我解释了任务，
你就必须接受我的请求。

scripts.text: Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下。

scripts.text: Yes, sure.
scripts.translation: 是的，准备好了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I understand, but if you
change your mind, please
come back and let me know.
It's very hard for me to find
someone that I can really
rely on to do this for me...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我理解，但如果你改变主意，
请回来告诉我。
对我来说，找到一个真正可以
信赖的人来做这件事非常困难...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, I'm relieved to see
that you accept. Don't worry,
this task isn't complicated,
nor will it require much
in the way of sacrifice.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，很高兴你接受了。
别担心，这个任务并不复杂，
也不需要太多的牺牲。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
As you may already know,
our country of Arunafeltz
worships the goddess Freya.
There's almost no separation
between politics, society,
and our religion, really.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
你可能已经知道了，
我们的国家阿鲁纳菲兹
崇拜女神弗蕾雅。
实际上，政治、社会和宗教之间
几乎没有界限。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Now, the leader of our
national religion, our pope,
is a direct servant of Freya
and delivers her messages
to us. As such, she must live
by very strict guidelines.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我们国家宗教的领袖，也就是教皇，
是女神弗蕾雅的直接侍从，
负责将她的旨意传达给我们。
因此，她必须遵循非常严格的准则。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Our pope is curious about
the outside world and wishes
to learn more about what lies
beyond Arunafeltz, but she
cannot come easily by this
sort of knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我们的教皇对外界很好奇，
希望能了解更多阿鲁纳菲兹之外的世界，
但她很难轻易获得这方面的知识。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Firstly, she cannot leave
Rachel, the place where the
spirit of goddess Freya dwells.
Secondly, all citizens and priests are forbidden to leave the city in
order to preserve our sanctity.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
首先，她不能离开拉赫，
那是女神弗蕾雅的精神居所。
其次，为了维护圣地的纯洁性，
所有市民和牧师都被禁止离开城市。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
These are implicit rules that
normally aren't discussed openly,
but everyone follows them to
prevent from being stigmatized.
Frankly, I think it's somewhat shameful, but we're working on it.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
这些是心照不宣的规则，
通常不会公开讨论，
但每个人都遵守它们，
以免受到指责。
说实话，我觉得这有点丢人，
但我们正在努力改变这一点。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Furthermore, our pope must
maintain her image of aloof
piety, so it'd be inappropriate of her to openly question outside
world affairs. Although, such
knowledge would benefit her...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
此外，我们的教皇必须保持
超然虔诚的形象，
所以她公开询问外界事务是不合适的。
虽然，这些知识对她会有好处...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
That is why the high priests
decided to enlist a trustworthy
adventurer to inform our pope
about the outside world. Now
you understand why I've asked
you to keep all of this secret.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
这就是为什么大祭司们决定
聘请一位值得信赖的冒险者，
向我们的教皇汇报外界的情况。
现在你明白我为什么要求你
对这一切保密了吧。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You won't need to divulge
outrageous secrets or anything
like that. I presume mundane
details would be enough to
please her. Just let her be
able to envision your homeland.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
你不需要透露什么惊人的秘密
或类似的东西。
我想一些日常细节就足以
让她满意了。只要让她能
想象出你的家乡的样子即可。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Personally, I think it would
be refreshing for our pope to
hear a few of your stories as
she is always worshipping
our goddess on the behalf of
everyone in our glorious city.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
就我个人而言，我觉得
让我们的教皇听你讲几个故事
会让她耳目一新，
因为她一直代表着我们
辉煌城市里的所有人崇拜女神。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Unfortunately, I cannot escort
you to the priestess, but I will
relate the means to which you
can gain an audience with her.
First, you will need a ^FF0000High
Priest's Recommendation^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
不幸的是，我无法亲自
护送你去见女祭司，
但我可以告诉你如何
获得与她见面的机会。
首先，你需要一张^FF0000大祭司的推荐信^000000。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I will write that for you, so
there's no need to concern
yourself with that. Next, you
will need to gather ^FF000040 Glacial
Hearts^000000 as symbolic proof of
your strength and purity.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我会为你写好这张推荐信，
所以你不需要为此担心。
接下来，你需要收集^FF000040个冰块心脏^000000，
作为你力量和纯洁的象征性证明。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
While I finish writing this
recommendation, let me tell
you how to get to the pope's
office where you must go once
you gather 40 Glacial Hearts.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
在我写完这张推荐信的同时，
让我告诉你如何到达教皇执勤室，
当你收集齐40个冰块心脏后，
你必须去那里。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Head west from the chapel
in the center of the temple,
and then enter a door guarded
by two soldiers. Show them your
recommendation and Glacial Hearts, and they should grant you passage.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
从神庙中央的礼拜堂
向西走，然后进入一扇
由两名士兵看守的门。
向他们出示你的推荐信和冰块心脏，
他们应该会允许你通过。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, here you are.
I've finished writing
your recommendation.
Well then, I guess I'll
see you after you've
completed this task.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，你来了。
我已经写好了你的推荐信。
那么，我想在你
完成这个任务后再见。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a High
Priest's recommendation.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你获得了一张大祭司的推荐信。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Once you gather
^FF000040 Glacial Hearts^000000,
you can show them, along
with the recommendation I've
written for you, to the soldiers
guarding the pope's office.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
一旦你收集齐
^FF000040个冰块心脏^000000，
你可以将它们连同我为你
写好的推荐信一起，
出示给看守教皇执勤室的士兵。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
When you're ready to go
to the pope's office, just
head west from the chapel
to the center of the temple:
this is where the entrance is.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
当你准备好前往教皇执勤室时，
只需从礼拜堂向西走到
神庙中央：
入口就在这里。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, thank you so much
for spending some time
with the pope for me.
I can tell that she really
enjoyed speaking to you.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，非常感谢你
抽出时间陪我见教皇。
我能感觉到她真的很
享受与你的交谈。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I am curious, though...
Our pope is unaccustomed
to speaking with outsiders,
so I assume that you have
your own questions after
your conversation with her...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
不过，我很好奇...
我们的教皇不习惯与外人交谈，
所以我猜在与她交谈之后，
你自己也有一些问题想问...

scripts.text: Well, she did mention some Holy Ground...
scripts.translation: 嗯，她确实提到了圣地...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
What...?!
She mentioned
the Holy Ground...?!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
什么...？！
她提到了圣地...？！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The Holy Ground is a place
where all humans, including
the pope, have been forbidden.
We used to allow people to
visit in the past, but...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
圣地是一个连教皇在内的
所有人类都被禁止进入的地方。
过去我们曾允许人们参观，但是...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Only the gods can access
that place now. Listen, if
the other priests ask about
your conversation with the
pope, please do not make any
mention of the Holy Ground.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
现在只有神明才能进入那里。
听着，如果其他牧师问起
你和教皇的谈话，
请不要提及圣地。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please don't ask me
why, but believe me that
it's very important that
you feign ignorance of the
Holy Ground's existence!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
请不要问我为什么，
但相信我，
假装不知道圣地的存在
非常重要！

scripts.text:
[????]
Excuse me, Zhed?
May I speak with you
for a moment? I need
to talk to you about
a private matter...
scripts.translation:
[????]
打扰一下，泽德？
可以占用您一点时间吗？
我有一件私事需要和您谈谈...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Er, yes, of course!
Excuse me for a moment...
While you're waiting for me,
why don't you relax in the
next room? Don't forget:
there is no Holy Ground.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
呃，是的，当然可以！
请稍等片刻...
在您等待我的时候，
不妨去隔壁房间休息一下？
别忘了：
没有所谓的圣地。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'm sorry, but we're not
quite finished with our
discussion. Why don't you
wait and relax in the next room
over there in the meantime?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
抱歉，我们的谈话还没结束。
在此期间，
您不妨去那边隔壁房间
等待并休息一下？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I apologize for making
you wait for so long: I had
some crucial matters to
discuss. Now, that look
on your face tells me that
you have a pressing question.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
让您久等了，我很抱歉：
我有一些紧要的事情要讨论。
现在，您脸上的表情告诉我，
您有一个迫切的问题。

scripts.text: Ask about Bekento
scripts.translation: 询问关于贝肯托

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Bekento? Ah, you must
have been speaking to
High Priestess Niren.
She's the only one that
calls me that. You see, my
full name is Zhed Bekento.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
贝肯托？啊，您一定是
和大祭司 尼伦交谈过了。
只有她那样称呼我。
您看，我的全名是泽德·贝肯托。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Speaking of which...
Did Niren ask you anything
or tell you something that
was out of the ordinary?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
说到这个...
尼伦有没有问您什么，
或者告诉您什么
不寻常的事情？

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter a little hesitation,
you tell High Priest Zhed
about your conversation
with High Priestess Niren.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF稍作犹豫后，
您向大祭司 泽德讲述了
您与大祭司 尼伦的对话。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm, I see.
Yes. That sounds
like something she'd do.
I'll explain it all later, but
right now, I need to rest.
I'm getting old, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
嗯，我明白了。
是的。听起来像是她会做的事。
我稍后向您解释一切，
但现在，我需要休息。
毕竟我年纪大了，您知道的。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, but before you go, let
me warn you not to ^FF0000go near
the Holy Ground^000000. I repeat,
stay away from the Holy Ground.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，在您离开之前，
让我警告您不要^FF0000靠近圣地^000000。
我再说一遍，
远离圣地。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Holy Ground...
Why is High Priest Zhed
so adamant about protecting
the Holy Ground? Regardless...
If you want to go there, then
just go there. Who'll stop you?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF圣地...
为什么大祭司 泽德
如此坚决地要保护圣地？
无论如何...
如果您想去那里，
那就去吧。谁会阻止您呢？^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Whatever you do, whatever
journeys you take, please
make sure that you stay
away from the Holy Ground!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
无论您做什么，
无论您踏上怎样的旅程，
请务必远离圣地！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow, more than ever,
you feel compelled to
enter the Holy Ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF现在，比以往任何时候都更强烈地，
您感到必须进入圣地。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Oh, it's you.
Let me guess...
After everything I said,
you still went ahead and
visited the Holy Ground,
didn't you? Oh, well...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
哦，是你。
让我猜猜...
在我说了那么多之后，
你还是去了圣地，
对吧？唉，算了...

scripts.text: Did something happen?
scripts.translation: 发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well, honestly, I've been
temporarily suspended from
work, but no need to worry.
It's not your fault. I've been
in conflict with the other High
Priests for a while, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
嗯，老实说，
我被暂时停职了，
但不用担心。
这不是你的错。
反正我和其他大祭司
已经冲突了一段时间了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please don't worry about it.
If not this, they would have
found some other way to attack
me. It would only be a matter
of time. They're exaggerating
your intrusion for their benefit.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
请不要担心。
如果不是这件事，
他们也会找到其他办法攻击我。
这只是时间问题。
他们为了自己的利益，
夸大了你的闯入行为。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
All I want is for
Arunafeltz to be safe
and at peace. I hope this
land is not twisted by the
greedy humans. I hope all will
work according to Freya's will.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我所希望的，
只是阿鲁纳菲兹能够
安全且和平。
我希望这片土地
不会被贪婪的人类扭曲。
我希望一切
都能顺应芙蕾雅神的旨意。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, and please do not
blame Niren. She must have
her own reasons for her own
actions. She has changed
much but in the end, I think
that we are still friends.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，还有，请不要
责怪尼伦。
她做出那样的行为，
一定有她自己的理由。
虽然她改变了很多，
但归根结底，我认为
我们依然是朋友。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
One last thing:
try not to let the
other priests catch you
doing anything forbidden.
It'd be a little embarassing
for me, you understand.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
最后还有一点：
尽量别让其他祭司
发现你在做违禁的事。
那样对我来说
会有点尴尬，你明白吗。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Still, you were secretly
invited here, so I'm sure
that only a very few of them
would be able to recognize
you. In the end, you'll do
what you will, right?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
不过，既然你是被秘密
邀请来的，我相信
能认出你的人
应该寥寥无几。
到头来，你还是会
做你想做的事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
...I think I know what
you saw in the Holy Ground.
I'm sure that you have much
to ask, but now isn't the time
to seek for answers. Please,
you must be patient.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
...我想我知道
你在圣地看到了什么。
我相信你有很多
想要询问的问题，
但现在还不是
寻求答案的时候。
请，
你要耐心一些。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Until the right time
comes, I want you not
to tell anyone else what
you saw in the Holy Ground.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
在合适的时间
到来之前，我希望你
不要告诉任何人
你在圣地看到的事情。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well then, adventurer,
thank you for coming by.
I need to go lay down now,
so if you'll let me rest...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
那么，冒险者，
感谢你的来访。
我现在需要去躺下了，
如果你能让我休息...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, it's been a while,
hasn't it? You look well,
and I'm doing fine as you
can see. What can I do
for you today, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，好久不见，
是吗？你看起来气色不错，
我也很好，正如
你所见。今天有什么
我可以帮你的吗，{0}？

scripts.text: I just wanted to say hi.
scripts.translation: 只是想打个招呼

scripts.text: Ask About Veins Incident
scripts.translation: 询问伯仁斯事件

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
As you well know, I'm only
a High Priest in title, and
lost much of my influence
amongst many of the other
priests for my views.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
正如你所知，我仅仅
是名义上的大祭司，
因为我的观点，
我在其他祭司中
失去了很多影响力。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Still, I have faith that
justice and good will
prevail over the corruption
that plagues our priests,
so long as good people
are willing to act.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
尽管如此，我依然相信
正义和善良
终将战胜困扰我们祭司的
腐败，
只要善良的人们
愿意采取行动。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Veins incident?
I haven't heard of
anything... Well, perhaps
if you'd elaborate, then
I'd understand a bit more.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
伯仁斯事件？
我好像没听说过...
嗯，也许如果你
能详细说明一下，
我就能明白更多了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou told High Priest
Zhed about the group of
smugglers arrested in Veins.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你告诉了大祭司 泽德
关于在伯仁斯被捕的
走私团伙的事。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Oh, I think I did hear
something about that earlier.
Let's see now... Ah, right.
Niren mentioned something
strange about them...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
哦，我想我确实
之前听说过一些。
让我想想...啊，对了。
尼伦提到过关于他们的
一些奇怪的事情...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The smugglers were with
a high ranking official from
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom,
which is why Niren was so
hesitant to take any action
against them for a while.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
那些走私犯与
卢恩·米德加兹王国的
一位高官有关，
这就是为什么尼伦
在很长一段时间内
都犹豫着没有对他们
采取任何行动。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I was too preoccupied with
other matters, and I didn't
think much of it at the time.
Why don't you speak to Niren?
I'm sure that she can tell you
more about what happened.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我当时太忙于其他事务，
所以当时没怎么在意。
你不妨去问问尼伦？
我相信她能告诉你
更多关于当时发生的事。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
If you do decide to
visit Niren, please
send her my regards.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
如果你决定
去拜访尼伦，请
代我向她问好。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, it does my heart to
good to see you again.
Adventurers willing to work
so hard for the sake of world
peace like yourself are fairly
uncommon. I hope you know that.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，再次见到你
真是令我欣慰。
像你这样愿意为了
世界和平而如此努力
的冒险者相当罕见。
我希望你知道这一点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
Please don't flatter
me like that! Saying
it like that is kind of
overdoing it, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
请不要这样
奉承我！
这么说有点
太过分了，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Not at all. In fact, I'm
sure that a place in
Valhalla has already
been secured for you
by the Valkyries. Now, how
may I help you, my friend?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
哪里哪里。事实上，我确信瓦尔基里们已经为你在英灵殿预留了位置。那么，我的朋友，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Mysterious Building in the Volcano
scripts.translation: 火山中的神秘建筑

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I was wondering
if you knew of anything about
this facility inside Thor
Volcano near Veins. There
might be something big
going on over there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我想知道你是否听说过伯仁斯附近托尔火山里的这个设施。那里似乎正在发生一些大事。

scripts.text:
^3131FFYou told High Priest
Zhed about the shackled
child in Thor Volcano, and
how you found the building
hidden there. High Priest Zhed
seemed disturbed by your words.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你向大祭司 泽德讲述了托尔火山中被锁链束缚的孩子，以及你在那里发现的隐藏建筑。大祭司 泽德似乎被你的话惊扰了。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I see. I have my suspicions
about what is happening. Now,
you're aware that Arunafeltz
is governed by our church,
and that our entire nation
worships the goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我明白了。我对那里发生的事有所怀疑。你知道，阿鲁纳菲兹是由我们的教会治理的，我们整个国家都崇拜女神芙蕾雅。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The priests that lead this
nation are split into two main
factions: I am considered part
of the moderate faction, which
usually butts heads with the
jingoistic hard-liner faction.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
领导这个国家的祭司分为两大派系：我属于温和派，通常与好战的强硬派发生冲突。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
These hard-liner priests
are more than willing to use
violent methods if they believe
it to be the will of Freya, and
are the ones that established
the military camp  at Thor Volcano.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
这些强硬派祭司如果认为这是芙蕾雅的旨意，就毫不犹豫地采取暴力手段，正是他们在托尔火山建立了军事营地。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Of course, it's also
considered a geology camp
since they're always monitoring
that place for volcanic activity,
but for all intents and purposes,
they are training men to fight.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
当然，由于他们一直监测那里的火山活动，这也被视为一个地质营地，但归根结底，他们是在训练士兵作战。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
It scares me to think
about it, but I'm sure that
they have many military supplies
and machines of mass destruction
hidden over there in the camp.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
想到这些让我感到害怕，但我确信他们在营地里隐藏了大量的军事物资和大规模杀伤性机器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, what exactly do
they hope to accomplish
by fighting? How do they
intend to help the goddess
Freya by using violence?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，他们到底想通过战斗达成什么目的？他们打算如何通过暴力来帮助女神芙蕾雅？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
All the priests agree that
reassembling Ymir's Heart will
revive Freya. As you know, the
pieces are scattered all over
the world. Some are possessed
by the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
所有祭司都同意，重新组装尤弥尔之心将复活芙蕾雅。你知道，碎片散落在世界各地。有些被卢恩·米德加兹王国持有。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
In the interest of avoiding
conflict, the moderate faction
of priests decided to hire
scientists to reproduce Ymir's
Heart, resulting in an
imitation of that artifact.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
为了避免冲突，温和派祭司决定聘请科学家来复制尤弥尔之心，从而制造出了该神器的仿制品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
An imitation of Ymir's
Heart? I think I know of
a famous scientist from the
Schwarzwald Republic that
was working on that! Let's
see, his name was...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤弥尔之心的仿制品？我想我知道修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国有一位著名的科学家正在研究这个！让我想想，他的名字是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't the scientist's name...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那位科学家的名字是...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Oh, you've heard of him?
Yes, his name was Varmunt.
Unfortunately, he deliberately
destroyed the Imitation of
Ymir's Heart into pieces,
and then disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
哦，你听说过他？是的，他的名字是瓦尔蒙特。不幸的是，他故意将尤弥尔之心的仿制品打碎，然后消失了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
{0}?
No, that wasn't him.
The man that created the
imitation of Ymir's Heart
was named Varmunt.
He was truly a genius.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
{0}？
不，不是他。
制造尤弥尔之心仿制品的那位先生名叫瓦尔蒙特。
他确实是个天才。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'm not sure what happened
to Varmunt. All I know was that
something serious happened
in the Schwarzwald Republic,
and that he disappeared in
the fiasco. It's strange...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我不确定瓦尔蒙特后来怎么样了。我只知道修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国发生了一些严重的事情，而他在混乱中消失了。这很奇怪...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Although the working
Ymir's Heart imitation that
Varmunt had created was broken
into pieces, other scientists
managed to mostly reproduce
his work with unstable Ymir Hearts.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
虽然瓦尔蒙特制造的可用尤弥尔之心仿制品被打碎了，但其他科学家设法主要复制了他的工作，制造出了不稳定的尤弥尔之心。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Since our moderate faction,
was only able to provide
unstable Ymir Heart imitations,
the hard-liner faction quickly
gained more respectability than
us in the eyes of the people.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
由于我们的温和派只能提供不稳定的尤弥尔之心仿制品，强硬派在民众眼中迅速获得了比我们要高的威望。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Despite our advanced weaponry
and armor, I'm afraid that our
country of Arunafeltz is not as
civilized and peaceful as I'd
like it to be, and the hard-liners
control our government now.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
尽管我们拥有先进的武器和盔甲，但我恐怕阿鲁纳菲兹并没有我期望的那样文明与和平。如今，强硬派已经控制了我们的政府。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Although the hard-liners
allowed us to continue
our research in faithfully
reproducing Ymir's Heart,
they've been developing their
military might unopposed.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
虽然强硬派允许我们继续忠实地复制尤弥尔之心的研究，但他们一直在肆无忌惮地发展军事实力。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
So basically, the moderates
are trying to recreate Ymir's
Heart at research centers
in the Holy Ground and the
Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
基本上，温和派正在圣地和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的研究中心尝试重现尤弥尔之心。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The hard-liners are
training soldiers and
storing up military supplies
and weapons in their camp
in Thor Volcano. However,
I don't know any more details.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
强硬派正在训练士兵，并在托尔火山营地囤积军用物资和武器。不过，我不清楚更多细节。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This doesn't look good.
I mean, if they're gearing
up to take the Ymir Heart
Pieces by force, it'll be war
against the Schwalzvalt Republic
and the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这看起来不妙。
我是说，如果他们打算强行夺取尤弥尔心脏堆积物，那将是对修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国和卢恩·米德加兹王国的宣战！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Seeing as I'm part of the
moderate faction, as well as
recently demoted, I just don't
have access to much information
about the hard-liners. However,
there may still be hope yet...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
鉴于我是温和派的一员，而且最近刚被降职，我很难获取关于强硬派的太多情报。不过，也许还有希望...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
War would be bad for all
parties involved. That is
why I'd like to ask you to
sneak into the camp at
Thor Volcano for the sake of
protecting international peace.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
战争对所有相关方都是灾难。因此，为了维护国际和平，我想请你潜入托尔火山的营地。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I really want to know
more about what they're
planning to do, but that
place is heavily guarded!
How am I going to sneak in?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我真的很想知道他们打算做什么，但那个地方守卫森严！
我该怎么潜进去呢？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You're right.
We'll have to think
of a really good way
for you to infiltrate
that place. Hmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
你说得对。
我们必须想出一个好办法让你渗透进去。嗯...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
嗯...

scripts.text: How to Sneak into the Camp
scripts.translation: 如何潜入营地

scripts.text: The Moderates
scripts.translation: 温和派

scripts.text: The Hard-Liners
scripts.translation: 强硬派

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I still don't have any
ideas for sneaking into
the camp at Thor Volcano.
Give me a little more time,
and hopefully we can figure
something out together.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我还没有想出潜入托尔火山营地的办法。
请再给我一点时间，希望我们能一起想出对策。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
We priests of the moderate
faction are opposed to war,
so we've been trying to
develop imitations of Ymir's
Heart for a long time. We've
yet to succeed, unfortunately.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我们温和派的牧师反对战争，所以长期以来一直在尝试开发尤弥尔之心的仿制品。不幸的是，我们尚未成功。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The hard-liners actually
opposed our efforts, but
they've let us continue since
they think they can eventually
use imitation Ymir Hearts for
military purposes.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
强硬派其实反对我们的努力，但他们认为最终可以将尤弥尔之心的仿制品用于军事目的，所以允许我们继续。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The Ymir Heart reproduction
project has been frustrating
the best minds in the world,
and some scientists have even
resorted to using forbidden
methods. It's a shame, really.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
尤弥尔之心复制项目让世界上最聪明的人感到沮丧，一些科学家甚至 resort 到了使用禁忌的方法。这真是令人遗憾。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Varmunt actually succeeded
in recreating Ymir's Heart,
but then he destroyed it and
he disappeared. He did it to
prevent war, but we could
really use his help now.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
瓦尔蒙特实际上成功重现了尤弥尔之心，但他随后将其摧毁并消失了。他这样做是为了防止战争，但现在我们真的很需要他的帮助。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The hard-liners are especially
fanatical in their devotion to
Freya, and will use any means
to further what they interpret
as her will. They're willing to
go to war for their beliefs.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
强硬派对芙蕾雅尤其狂热，他们会不惜一切手段来推行他们解读的神意。他们愿意为信仰而战。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The fact that they've even
built a military camp in Thor
Volcano disturbs me greatly.
It's almost certain that they
intend to wage war against any
nation with a Ymir's Heart piece.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
他们甚至在托尔火山建立了军事营地，这让我深感不安。几乎可以肯定，他们打算对任何拥有尤弥尔心脏堆积物的国家发动战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who is in charge of that
camp at Thor's Volcano?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
托尔火山后勤基地的营地是由谁负责的？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
High Priest Vildt.
He's in charge of all
important buildings in
Arunafeltz. His room is at
the other side of the building,
but it's always heavily guarded.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
是大祭司 维尔德。
他负责阿鲁纳菲兹所有重要建筑的管理。他的房间在建筑的另一侧，但那里总是戒备森严。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Vildt is one of the
highest ranking members
of the hard-liner priest
faction. He rarely makes it
his business to see anybody
that he sees as beneath him.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
维尔德是强硬派神官派系中地位最高的人物之一。他很少会屈尊去见他认为地位低下的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would you please
take a look at this
file, High Priest Zhed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大祭司 泽德，请您看一下这份文件好吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Of course.
Let's see, what's
in this File Folder?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
当然可以。
让我看看，这个薄的档案夹里有什么？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
This is a geological
report about Thor Volcano?
Ah, I see. They must have
someone regularly check
to see if it will erupt.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
这是一份关于托尔火山后勤基地的地质报告？
啊，我明白了。他们一定安排了专人定期监测火山是否会喷发。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Although it's fairly dangerous
to build a military camp there,
some weapon materials can
only be forged from the heat
coming from Thor's Volcano.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
虽然在那里建立军事营地相当危险，但有些武器材料只能利用托尔火山后勤基地的热量来锻造。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Yes, I think it's also
likely that there are special
weapon crafting metals and
materials that can only be
found on the volcano. That
makes perfect sense.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
是的，我认为那里很可能还有特殊的武器锻造金属和材料，且只能在火山找到。这完全说得通。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Although the volcano is
dormant now, these reports
claim that the volcano is
either safe or ready to erupt
at any time. The data here
doesn't make any sense.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
虽然火山目前处于休眠状态，但这些报告声称火山要么安全，要么随时可能喷发。这里的数据毫无逻辑可言。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hm. This is just a hunch,
but seeing these discrepancies
in his reports, I really think this geologist has an agenda against
the camp at Thor Volcano.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
嗯。这只是我的直觉，但鉴于他报告中的这些矛盾之处，我真的很怀疑这位地质学家对托尔火山后勤基地的营地另有图谋。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You know, if that's true,
he might be able to help
you sneak into the camp.
Don't you think it's worth
checking out for now?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
你看，如果情况属实，他或许能帮你潜入营地。
你觉得现在去查一下值得吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well, you never know
until you ask. Besides,
I don't know if there's
any other way to sneak
into the Thor Volcano Camp...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
毕竟，不问问怎么知道结果呢。况且，我也不清楚还有没有其他办法能潜入托尔火山后勤基地...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I hope you'll go and talk
to the geologist. He should
be in Veins, the desert city
south of Rachel. He's your
best chance of entering the Thor
Volcano camp without suspicion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我希望你能去和那位地质学家谈谈。他应该在拉赫南边的沙漠城市伯仁斯。这是你不受怀疑地进入托尔火山后勤基地营地的最佳机会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
Where did I put
that File Folder?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦...？
我把那个薄的档案夹放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I hope you'll go and talk
to the geologist. He should
be in Veins, the desert city
south of Rachel. He's your
best chance of entering the Thor
Volcano camp without suspicion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我希望你能去和那位地质学家谈谈。他应该在拉赫南边的沙漠城市伯仁斯。这是你不受怀疑地进入托尔火山后勤基地营地的最佳机会。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I hope you'll go and talk
to the geologist. He should
be in Veins, the desert city
south of Rachel. He's your
best chance of entering the Thor
Volcano camp without suspicion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我希望你能去和那位地质学家谈谈。他应该在拉赫南边的沙漠城市伯仁斯。这是你不受怀疑地进入托尔火山后勤基地营地的最佳机会。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Oh! You're back!
Was that geologist able
to help you sneak into
the Thor Volcano camp?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
哦！你回来了！
那位地质学家能帮你潜入托尔火山后勤基地的营地吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
More than that. We've
convinced the camp that the
volcano is going to explode,
so they're scrambling to
evacuate. They're really
panicking over there!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不仅如此。我们已经让营地相信火山即将爆炸，所以他们正忙着疏散。那边的人真的慌了神！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hahaha! That's great!
Even if they do figure
out that they've been
fooled, it will take them
some time to realize it
in all that confusion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
哈哈哈！太好了！
即使他们最终发现被骗了，在那样的混乱中，也需要一段时间才能反应过来。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Yes, it might not be the
perfect time to bring down
the hard-liner faction right
now, but the opportunity
should present itself soon.
Thank you for all your help.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
是的，现在可能不是打击强硬派派系的完美时机，但机会很快就会出现的。感谢你的全力协助。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please relax for a while,
and I'll take care of the rest.
When the time to strike comes,
I will be contacting you again.
Together, we can protect
peace between our nations.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
请好好休息一会儿，剩下的交给我处理。
当行动的时刻到来时，我会再次联系你。
我们一起，守护国家间的和平。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'll be sure to contact
you again for your help
when the time is right.
I'm sure there are others
that may need you now...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
时机成熟时，我会再次联系你寻求帮助。
我相信现在肯定还有其他人需要你...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Welcome, adventurer.
I'm glad to see that you're
here. I think... I think an
opportunity has arisen in
which I could use your
expert assistance.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
欢迎，冒险者。
很高兴见到你。我想...我想出现了一个机会，需要你的专业协助。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Though, I fear that I may be
making the wrong decision.
After all, I no longer have
much influence among the
other priests... I can't help
but think I'm in the wrong.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
不过，我恐怕自己可能做出了错误的决定。
毕竟，我在其他牧师中的影响力已经大不如前...我不禁怀疑自己是否走错了路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't lose heart,
High Priest Zhed.
I... I believe in you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不要灰心，大祭司 泽德。
我...我相信你！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I guess you're right.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
你说得对。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
As you well know, the
highest authority in
Arunafeltz is our Pope,
the reincarnation of
our goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
正如你所知，阿鲁纳菲兹的最高权威是我们的教皇，她是女神芙蕾雅转世。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Unfortunately, she is too
young and innocent, and she
doesn't yet have the experience
to assert control, and stamp
out the in-fighting and
corruption among the priests.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
不幸的是，她还太年轻、太天真，缺乏足够的经验来掌控局面，并平息牧师们内部的争斗与腐败。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
In these desperate times,
we will need someone to
provide strong and confident
leadership to the people
of Arunafeltz before all
is lost to war and violence.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
在这个危急时刻，我们需要有人为阿鲁纳菲兹的人民提供坚定而自信的领导力，以免一切在战争与暴力中毁灭。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I know it may not be
right, but someone
must do something
before the other High
Priests ruin our nation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
^333333*叹息...*^000000
我知道这可能并不正确，但在其他大祭司毁掉我们的国家之前，必须有人采取行动。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Y-you're not thinking
of overthrowing the
pope are you? I-isn't
that a bit extreme?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你不会是想推翻教皇吧？这...这不是很极端吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
What? No, no!
Don't jump to conclusions
like that! Don't misunderstand
me: I'm loyal to our pope.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
什么？不，不！
不要那样妄下结论！别误会我：我对我们的教皇忠心耿耿。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I actually want to work
very closely with the pope,
in essense, rule together with
her by combining my experience
and her wisdom. It's ambitious,
but what else can I do?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我其实想与教皇紧密合作，本质上是将我的经验与她的智慧结合，共同治理。这很宏大，但我还能做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You remember how you
stopped the hard-liner
priests from carrying out
their plans for war in the
Thor Volcano camp? That will
only stop them temporarily.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
你还记得你如何阻止强硬派牧师在托尔火山后勤基地执行他们的战争计划吗？那只能暂时阻止他们。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
They'll eventually prepare
to act out in violence again.
We need a permanent solution
to ensure that this sort of
thing doesn't happen again.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
他们最终还是会再次准备采取暴力行动。我们需要一个永久的解决方案，以确保这种事不再发生。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
We need to convince the
pope to finally act, and
give my policy of peace
her full support. Will
you help me to do this?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我们需要说服教皇最终采取行动，并全力支持我的和平政策。你愿意帮我做到这一点吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
Well... Asking for the
pope's support is the only
solution I've been able to
find. Do you have any ideas
for protecting peace here
in Arunafeltz?
scripts.translation: 嗯...寻求教皇的支持是我目前能找到的唯一解决办法。对于如何守护阿鲁纳菲兹的和平，你有什么想法吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well, I don't know.
It's a good idea, but
I fear that it will only
be effective in the short
term. Why don't we just
try what I've proposed first?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
嗯，我不知道。
这是个好主意，但我担心它只能短期有效。我们何不先试试我提出的方案？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm, now how can
we convince the pope to
support us? Even as Freya's
reincarnation... She's just
a young girl. She probably
knows nothing of politics.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
嗯，那我们该如何说服教皇支持我们呢？即使是芙蕾雅的转世...她也只是个年轻女孩。她可能对政治一无所知。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
It'd probably be best to
tell her exactly what is
happening. The full truth.
In my heart, I know that
would be best.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
最好告诉她正在发生的一切。全部的真相。在我心里，我知道那是最好的办法。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
But... Maybe it would
be better if we sugar
coated it a little bit.
She might not be too
receptive to us if we
totally shock her.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
但是...也许我们最好稍微委婉一点。
如果我们直接告诉她全部真相，
她可能会受到太大冲击，
从而对我们产生抵触。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm... What do you
think? Should we stick
with the truth, or do you
think it'd be better if we
exaggerate and... lie when
we feel it's necessary?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
嗯...你觉得呢？
我们是坚持说真话，
还是你觉得在必要时
夸大其词...甚至撒谎会更好？

scripts.text: Truth
scripts.translation: 真话

scripts.text: Lies
scripts.translation: 谎言

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
That's what I think too.
Although I'm worried about
how the pope will react at
our message, I should have
faith. I should have faith.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我也这么认为。
虽然我很担心教皇听到我们的消息后会作何反应，
但我应该保持信任。我应该保持信任。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I suppose that you may
have a point. It might not
be a good idea to totally
expose her to the ugly
truth. I'll try to be as
honest as I can...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我想你也许有道理。
完全向她揭露丑陋的真相可能不是个好主意。
我会尽量保持诚实...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well, there's no time
to waste. The two of us may
not be enough to convince
the pope to act for peace.
I already have someone in
mind that might help us.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
好了，没时间浪费了。
我们两个人可能不足以说服教皇为和平采取行动。
我已经想到一个可能帮上忙的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That sounds good.
Who is he?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
听起来不错。
他是谁？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
My old friend, High Priest
Niren. I'm not sure if she'll
help me after all that's
happened between us. She
may even think I deserve
to be excommunicated...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我的老朋友，大祭司尼伦。
我不确定在发生那些事之后，
她是否还会帮我。
她甚至可能认为我理应被逐出教门...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Come on, it wouldn't
hurt to try! Besides,
Niren isn't a bad person.
Maybe she'll understand
the way you see things
if you explain them?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
来吧，试一试又不会有什么坏处！
而且，尼伦并不是个坏人。
如果你解释清楚，
也许她会理解你的看法？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You're right, of course.
I'm just grasping at straws
here, but she and I both used
to believe that peace was
possible. I don't know why
she joined the hard-liners...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
你说得对，当然。
我只是在孤注一掷，
但她和我过去都相信和平是可能的。
我不知道她为什么加入了强硬派...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
{0}...
Would you please talk to
her, and just see how she's
doing? It might not be a good
time to mention our plan
right away, though...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
{0}...
请你去和她谈谈，
看看她最近怎么样？
不过，也许现在还不是
立刻提及我们计划的好时机...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
If you think that you
have a chance of convincing
her, then feel free and offer
my proposal. Her office is
located across from here,
but she's always very busy...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
如果你觉得你有机会说服她，
那就尽管提出我的建议吧。
她的办公室就在对面，
但她总是很忙...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
There's actually
a good chance that
she is away somewhere
on business. She is highly
loved by the people, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
实际上，她很可能
正外出处理公务。
你知道的，她很受民众爱戴。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please speak to Niren,
and she if she'd be willing
to help us convince the pope
to enforce peace in our nation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
请去和尼伦对话，
问问她是否愿意帮助我们
说服教皇在我国推行和平。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Welcome back.
So did you get a chance
to speak to Niren? How did
she respond to my proposal?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
欢迎回来。
你有机会和尼伦谈谈吗？
她对我的建议有什么反应？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou explain Niren's reasons
for her disappointment in
the Moderate priest faction,
and tell Zhed that she intends
to carry out the plans for war.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向泽德解释了尼伦对温和派牧师派系感到失望的原因，并告诉她打算执行战争计划。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm... This explains why
she and some other high
priests started being absent
from their offices. Many of
them were invited over to
the Schwarzwald Republic...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
嗯...这就解释了为什么她和其他一些大祭司
开始缺席他们的办公室。
他们中的许多人被邀请到了修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Regardless, I know for
a fact that war is never
a solution. It only brings
death and destruction.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
无论如何，我确信战争从来不是解决方案。
它只会带来死亡和毁灭。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Give me a moment.
I'm going to write
a letter that I want
you to give to Niren.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
请给我一点时间。
我要写一封信，
希望你能把它交给尼伦。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please bring this letter
to Niren. I hope what
I have to say will help
her understand how I feel
about these plans for war.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
请把这封信带给尼伦。
我希望我说的话能让她理解
我对这些战争计划的感受。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a letter for
Niren from High Priest Zhed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你收到了大祭司 泽德给尼伦的信件。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please deliver my
letter to Niren as
soon as you can.
I really appreciate
you helping me on this.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
请尽快把我的信交给尼伦。
非常感谢你在这件事上帮我的忙。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Great news! Niren just
sent me a reply: I can't
believe that she's willing
to help me! Would you please
give her any help that she
may need from now on?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
好消息！尼伦刚刚给我回了信：
我简直不敢相信她愿意帮我！
从现在起，如果她需要任何帮助，
请你务必协助她，好吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, I've been
waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
啊，我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
High Priest Zhed,
everything's ready!
High Priest Niren managed
to send away all of those
followers that were near the
pope. You won't be interrupted.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大祭司 泽德，
一切准备就绪！
大祭司 尼伦已经设法
让教皇身边的所有信徒都离开了。
您不会被打扰的。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I hope we can get the pope
to understand the situation
of our nation. I only...
Oh, Freya help us...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我希望能让教皇理解我们国家的处境。
只是...
哦，芙蕾雅女神保佑我们...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Alright, I'm ready.
Let's receive an
audience with the
pope, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
好了，我准备好了。
我们去见教皇吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'm a little nervous
about talking so brazenly
to the pope, but I'm
ready to go meet her.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我要如此直率地和教皇交谈，
我有点紧张，
但我已经准备好去见她了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I believe that Niren
has something important
to tell you. Why don't
you speak to her before
coming back to me?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我相信尼伦有重要的事情要告诉你。
在你回来找我之前，
为什么不先和她谈谈呢？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'm glad that everything
turned out great. Your
help was truly a blessing.
Although Schwarzwald will
continue their plans without
us, we've slowed them down.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
很高兴一切顺利。
你的帮助真是莫大的恩赐。
虽然修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德将继续他们的计划，
但我们已经拖延了他们的脚步。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Yes, without our support,
Schwarzwald won't have
any excuse to continue
their dangerous research
for a little while, at least.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
是的，没有我们的支持，
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德至少暂时
没有借口继续他们危险的研究了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Thor Volcano Camp
should close down soon,
now that we no longer
have any use for it.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
既然我们不再需要使用它，
托尔火山后勤基地应该很快就会关闭了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I also underestimated our
pope. She is more dignified,
willed that I believed.
I owe her my apologies.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我也低估了我们的教皇。
她比我以为的更有尊严，
意志更坚定。
我欠她一个道歉。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
We won't give up on
reviving our goddess Freya,
but we will retrieve Ymir's
Heart through diplomacy
rather than violence.
It won't be easy...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我们不会放弃复活女神芙蕾雅，
但我们将通过外交手段而非暴力
来取回尤弥尔之心。
这不会容易...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You've been instrumental
in returning peace here in
Arunafeltz. I've even been
reinstated, and will be very
busy from now on, working
closely with the pope...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
你为阿鲁纳菲兹恢复和平做出了巨大贡献。
我也被恢复了职位，
从现在起会很忙，
需要与教皇密切合作...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I know that the life of
adventuring beckons you.
I know she'd like to see
you before you leave, but
she's sleeping deeply after
that exhausting speech...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我知道冒险的生活在召唤着你。
我知道她想在你要离开前见你，
但在那场令人精疲力竭的演讲后，
她正在熟睡...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
On behalf of our pope
and all the citizens of
Arunafeltz, I'd like to
thank you for your heroism.
Your place in Valhalla is
already assured, I'm sure.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
代表我们的教皇和阿鲁纳菲兹的所有市民，
我想感谢你的英勇行为。
我相信，你在英灵殿的位置已经确定了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
May Freya bless you
on all your journeys,
my good friend.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
愿芙蕾雅保佑你
在所有的旅途中，
我亲爱的朋友。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ugh...!
I've got such
a horrible headache!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
唉...！
我头痛欲裂！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I should rest for now.
Please travel in safety.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
我现在应该休息一下。
请一路平安。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
May Freya be with you.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
愿芙蕾雅与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Good day.
Have you come to
redeem Lottery Tickets?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你好。
你是来兑换
彩票的吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
I already told you
everything I know.
Remember to keep
quiet about what I said.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
我已经把我知道的
都告诉你了。
记得对我说的话保密。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Greetings.
May Freya fill
your days with joy.
Laughter. And prosperity.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你好。
愿芙蕾雅让你的日子
充满喜悦、
欢笑和繁荣。

scripts.text: Redeem Lottery Tickets
scripts.translation: 兑换彩票

scripts.text: Temple Information
scripts.translation: 神殿资讯

scripts.text: Hey, what's happening?
scripts.translation: 嘿，发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Fine. You really
want to exchange your
Lottery Tickets? It's my job
to ask and make sure, you
know, in case you were saving
them for some weird reason.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
好吧。你真的
想兑换你的彩票吗？
这是我的职责，
必须确认一下，
以防你是因为
奇怪的原因才留着它们。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You can redeem your
Lottery Tickets at any
time, so please visit
me at your leisure.
Go with Freya.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你可以随时
兑换彩票，
请随时来找我。
愿芙蕾雅与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
The Chapel is located
over the wall behind me.
Our pope's office and chambers
are upstairs. You can only go
there if you have special
authorization.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
小教堂位于
我身后的墙上方。
教皇的办公室和寝室
在楼上。只有持有
特别授权才能进入。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You come to a temple
to pray, not to look
around. Or chit-chat
with the priestesses
like me. Don't forget it.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你来神殿是为了祈祷，
不是为了四处张望。
也不是为了像我这样的
女祭司闲聊。别忘了这一点。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
The offices for the High
Priests are located on each
side of the hallway. However,
you can only enter if you've
been permitted beforehand.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
大祭司的办公室位于
走廊的两侧。但是，
只有事先获得许可
才能进入。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
......................
No chit-chat
inside the temple.

[Priestess Panno]
Good day.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你好。

scripts.text: Redeem Lottery Tickets
scripts.translation: 兑换彩票

scripts.text: Temple Information
scripts.translation: 神殿资讯

scripts.text: Hey, did you open the gate?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你打开门了吗？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You... still have
Lottery Tickets from
making donations for
the festival? Look up the
word ''punctuality'' in the
dictionary. It might help you.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你...还留着为节日捐款获得的彩票吗？去查查字典里“守时”这个词的意思吧。也许对你会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Fine. You really
want to exchange your
Lottery Tickets? It's my job
to ask and make sure, you
know, in case you were saving
them for some weird reason.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
好吧。你真的
想兑换你的彩票吗？
这是我的职责，
必须确认一下，
以防你是因为
奇怪的原因才留着它们。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You can redeem your
Lottery Tickets at any
time, so please visit
me at your leisure.
Go with Freya.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你可以随时
兑换彩票，
请随时来找我。
愿芙蕾雅与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
The Chapel is located
over the wall behind me
Our pope's office and chambers
are upstairs. You can only go
there if you have special
authorization.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
小教堂位于我身后的墙后。
教皇的办公室和寝宫在楼上。
只有持有特别许可的人才能进入那里。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You come to a temple
to pray, not to look
around. Or chit-chat
with the priestesses
like me. Don't forget it.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你来神殿是为了祈祷，
不是为了四处张望。
也不是为了像我这样的
女祭司闲聊。别忘了这一点。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
The offices for the High
Priests are located on each
side of the hallway. However,
you can only enter if you've
been permitted beforehand.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
大祭司的办公室位于
走廊的两侧。但是，
只有事先获得许可
才能进入。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Gate...?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
门...？

scripts.text: The locked gate to the temple!
scripts.translation: 通往神殿的锁住的门！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
I don't know
what you mean.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
我不知道你在说什么。

scripts.text: Explain
scripts.translation: 解释

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think that Priestess Nemma
has been worried about the
gate being broken, though
it hasn't been like that since
you've started your position
here at the temple.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得女祭司奈玛一直很担心门被破坏，
不过自从你在这里任职以来，
这种情况就没有再发生过。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Worried...?
Yes, my twin sister
has been known to
do a lot of that, and cry
for my help. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
担心...？
是的，我的双胞胎姐姐
确实经常那样，
还会哭着向我求助。我说得对吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's weird
...She said that the gate
should automatically fix
itself, but it hasn't been
doing it lately. She was
acting really funny..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真奇怪
...她说门应该会自动修复，
但最近一直没有这样做。
她的表现真的很奇怪..

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She was talking about
the temple's history and
how the security system was
built. Then she mentioned you,
so I get the feeling you might
know something about this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她在谈论神殿的历史，
以及安保系统是如何建造的。
然后她提到了你，
所以我感觉你可能知道一些关于这件事的内情。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
.........

[{0}]
I remember now...!
I was there when the gate
closed, and I heard someone
with your exact voice whisper
something to magically open
the gate! What's that all about?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想起来了...！
门关上时我就在那里，
我听到有人用和你一模一样的声音低语，
用魔法打开了门！这是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Nemma and I are descended
from a family of great alchemists.
They went on a long, religious
pilgrimage and ended up here.
They are the ones that built
this temple and security system.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
奈玛和我都出身于一个伟大的炼金术士家族。
他们进行了一次漫长的宗教朝圣，
最终来到了这里。
正是他们建造了这座神殿和安保系统。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
In a sense, this temple
is the tomb of our ancestors,
who left Rune-Midgarts and
built this city of Rachel about
a thousand years ago.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
从某种意义上说，这座神殿
是我们祖先的坟墓，
他们离开卢恩·米德加兹，
约一千年前建造了拉赫这座城市。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Over the generations, many
Alchemists left Rune-Midgarts
and settled here, converting
the desert into green fields.
This temple was supposed
be a shelter from intruders.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
经过几代人的时间，许多炼金术士
离开卢恩·米德加兹并在此定居，
将沙漠变成了绿色的田野。
这座神殿原本是为了抵御入侵者而建的避难所。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
My ancestor designed the
temple security system to
require a special permit in
order to access the temple
But the invaders never came,
and we didn't need the permits.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
我的祖先设计了神殿的安保系统，
要求持有特别许可才能进入神殿。
但入侵者从未到来，
我们也不需要那些许可。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
The special permits were
disposed, but the automatic
security system was left on
the gate, just in case. Now,
I've heard that the security
system has been malfunctioning.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
特别许可已经被销毁，
但自动安保系统仍保留在门上，
以防万一。现在，
我听说安保系统出现了故障。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
However, that's not possible.
Even by today's standards, the
system is perfectly designed.
While I was praying in the
Chapel some time ago, I found
what is causing the gate problems.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
然而，这是不可能的。
即使以今天的标准来看，
该系统也是完美设计的。
不久前我在小教堂祈祷时，
发现了导致门故障的原因。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Suddenly, the lights went
out, and I could only barely
see distinguish my surroundings.
I was about to go outside when
I heard a noise from the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
突然，灯灭了，
我几乎看不清周围的环境。
我正要走出去，
就听到楼梯上传来声响。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
From what I can tell,
someone is transporting
something out of the Holy
Grounds. I don't know what
they keep there, though.
I'm not a high rank Priestess.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
据我观察，
有人正在把什么东西
运出圣地。
不过我不知道他们在那里藏了什么，
毕竟我不是高阶女祭司。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
I'm not sure if I want
to find out what's there
I heard something that
sounded like a horrible
monster's howl. It was
incredibly frightening.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
我不确定自己是否想知道那里有什么。
我听到了一声听起来像
可怕魔物嚎叫的声音。
那真是令人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
I panicked, ran to
my desk at the front,
and just recited the secret
password passed down from my
ancestors to open the gate.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
我惊慌失措，跑回前台，
背诵了祖先传下来的秘密口令
来打开大门。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You see, my ancestors
included the secret password
and voice recognition feature
into the gate in case something
after they disposed of the
temple permits--just in case.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你看，我的祖先
在大门上设置了秘密口令
和语音识别功能，
以防他们在销毁神殿许可后
发生什么意外——以防万一。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
The real reason why the gate
is acting strangely is not
because the gate is broken,
but because someone is sneaking
in and out of the Holy Ground.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
大门行为异常的真正原因
并不是门坏了，
而是有人正在偷偷进出圣地。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Whoever they are, they
must be using one of the
old temple permits in order
to cover their tracks. Now,
you know everything.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
不管他们是谁，
他们一定在使用旧的神殿许可
来掩盖行踪。现在，
你已经知道一切了。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You'd better not
reveal what you learned
from me. Otherwise, I'm
sure we'll end up dead.
Excuse me now, I need
to get back to work.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你最好不要泄露
从我这里听到的事。
否则，我们肯定都会死。
失陪了，我得回去工作了。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
This is a holy place
Behave yourself, and
respect those who have
come here just to worship.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
这里是神圣之地。
请举止得体，
尊重那些前来礼拜的人。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You're carrying too much
right now. What are you
going to do if I give you
something large, unwieldy
and heavy? Put your junk
away in Storage first.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你现在携带的东西太多了。
如果我给你一样又大又笨重
的东西，你打算怎么办？
先把你的杂物放进仓库吧。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
Here we go
Excited? Mm
I can redeem only
1 Lottery Ticket at
a time. Your reward
for this ticket is...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
好了。
很兴奋吗？嗯。
我一次只能兑换
1张彩票。这张彩票的奖励是...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
^FF0000This^000000. It's been in our
storage for a while, but
I hope this is acceptable
as a token of the temple's
gratitude. May Freya smile
upon you for your generosity...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
^FF0000这个^000000。它在我们仓库里放了有一阵子了，
但我希望它能作为神殿
感激之意的象征被接受。
愿弗蕾雅保佑你的慷慨...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You...
Don't have any Lottery
Tickets to redeem.
We're not distributing
them now, but maybe you
can ask your friends for one.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你...
没有可以兑换的彩票。
我们现在不发放彩票，
但也许你可以向朋友要一张。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
You...
Don't have any Lottery
Tickets to redeem.
You can obtain them from
Priestess Nemma at the temple
entrance after you donate zeny.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
你...
没有可以兑换的彩票。
你可以在捐赠Zeny后，
从神殿入口的女祭司 奈玛那里获得彩票。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Panno]
May Freya be with you.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 潘诺]
愿弗蕾雅与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Pope's Office Guard]
Hm? What's that you have
there? Oh, you've gathered
40 Glacial Hearts and brought
a recommendation letter from
a High Priest? Most impressive.
scripts.translation:
[教皇办公室卫兵]
嗯？你手里拿的是什么？
哦，你收集了40个冰块心脏，
还带来了神官的推荐信？
真是令人印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Pope's Office Guard]
I think I know why you're
here. Thanks for bringing
those to me, and I'll let you
enter and see the pope
Welcome, brave {0}.
scripts.translation:
[教皇办公室卫兵]
我想我知道你为什么来了。
谢谢你把这些带给我，
我会让你进去见教皇。
欢迎，勇敢的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Pope's Office Guard]
The pope is inside
expecting you, so please
don't keep her waiting long.
scripts.translation:
[教皇办公室卫兵]
教皇在里面等你，
请不要让她等太久。

scripts.text: - Niren told me to pay a visit to the Pope in her office... -
scripts.translation: - 尼伦让我去教皇执勤室拜访教皇... -

scripts.text:
[Pope's Office Guard]
I'm sorry, but outsiders
typically aren't allowed
to visit the pope without
special authorization.
scripts.translation:
[教皇办公室卫兵]
很抱歉，通常没有特别授权，
外人是不允许拜访教皇的。

scripts.text:
[Pope's Office Guard]
I'm sorry, but the pope
is officiating a service
now. Please come back
after the service is ended.
scripts.translation:
[教皇办公室卫兵]
很抱歉，教皇现在正在主持仪式。
请等仪式结束后再来。

scripts.text:
[Pope's Office Guard]
I'm sorry, but the pope
is officiating a service
now. Please come back
after the service is ended.
scripts.translation:
[教皇办公室卫兵]
很抱歉，教皇现在正在主持仪式。
请等仪式结束后再来。

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked.^000000

[Priest]
May Freya be with you.
scripts.translation:
[牧师]
愿芙蕾雅与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Male Follower]
May Freya be with you.
scripts.translation:
[男性信徒]
愿芙蕾雅与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Priestess]
May Freya be with you.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司]
愿芙蕾雅与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Female Follower]
May Freya be with you.
scripts.translation:
[女性信徒]
愿芙蕾雅与你同在。

scripts.text:
^3355FFTh-this little
girl is the pope...?!^000000

[Pope]
...............................
..........................Um...
W-welcome. Is something
wrong? Oh, I know, it's my
eyes. I'm sorry if they
scare you a little bit.
No, not at all...!
scripts.translation: 不，完全没有...！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
......
......
......You know, my appearance...

[Pope]
It's alright. Actually,
I'm used to it. People
are usually a little shocked
the first time they see me.
So... Um... Where do you
come from, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
没关系。其实，
我已经习惯了。人们第一次
看到我时通常会感到有点震惊。
所以...那个...你来自哪里，{0}？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
{0}...?
I think I might have heard
about that place before.
Wow... What did you do
when you lived there?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
{0}...？
我想我以前可能听说过
那个地方。
哇...你在那里生活时
都做些什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
{0}...?
Wow, that sounds quite
extraordinary. Ooh, ooh!
Tell me, how have you come
here to Rachel? I'm interested
in knowing more about you~
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
{0}...？
哇，听起来相当非凡。噢，噢！
告诉我，你是怎么来到拉赫的？
我想知道更多关于你的事~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou and the pope
continued to comfortably
converse. As she spoke, she
seemed more like a young,
lonely girl than a solemn
religious figure for a nation.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你和教皇愉快地
交谈着。当她说话时，
她看起来更像是一个孤独的年轻女孩，
而不是一个国家的庄严宗教领袖。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pope]
...Wow, sometimes, I really
wish I could live like you.
You'd think being pope would
be great, but they make me work
all the time. And there are all
sorts of things I can't do.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
...哇，有时候，我真的
希望能像你一样生活。
你以为当教皇会很棒，
但他们让我一直工作。
而且有很多事情我不能做。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
You know what's weird?
I think I'm the head of this
religion, but there's a sacred
place that even I'm not allowed
to visit. Isn't that so weird?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
你知道什么很奇怪吗？
我想我是这个宗教的领袖，
但有一个神圣的地方，
连我都不被允许进入。
这不是很奇怪吗？

scripts.text: R-really...?

[Pope]
...Yeah. I don't know
much about, and I'm not
really supposed to talk
about it. We just call this
place the ''Holy Ground...''
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
...是的。我不太了解，
而且我也不应该谈论它。
我们只是把这个地方
称为“圣地...”

scripts.text: Holy Ground?
scripts.translation: 圣地？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I'm sorry... I want
to tell you more, but...
That's all I know. I wonder...
I wonder what they could
be hiding over there...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
对不起...我想
告诉你更多，但是...
我只知道这些。我想知道...
我想知道他们在那里
可能隐藏着什么...

scripts.text:
[Priest]
I'm sorry to interrupt
your Excellency, but it's
time to officiate services.
Pardon me.
scripts.translation:
[牧师]
很抱歉打扰您，陛下，
现在是主持仪式的时间了。
请原谅。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Already?! Hmpf...
Oh, before I forget,
I needed to tell you that
High Priest Zhed wanted
to talk to you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
已经这么晚了吗？哼...
啊，差点忘了，
大祭司 泽德想见你，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I really want to thank
you for coming to speak
to me. I had a great time
learning. Now I have to
go officiate services, so...
This is goodbye for now...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
真的很感谢你愿意来和我对话。
和你一起学习让我很开心。
现在我要去主持仪式了，所以...
暂时就到这里吧...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Oh, that's right...
Zhed... Er, High Priest
Zhed wanted to speak to you!
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
哦，对了...
泽德...呃，大祭司 泽德想和你对话！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Oh, hello! It's you again!
Have you come to tell me
interesting stories about
the outside world again?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
哦，你好！又是你啊！
你是来给我讲外面世界
的有趣故事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Mm. That sounds pretty
strange to me. Well, it's
good to hear it from you.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
嗯。听起来挺奇怪的。
不过，能听到你这么说，
我也很高兴。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333I can't just leave
now. I should try to see
if I can learn anything
useful from the pope...^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333现在不能就这样离开。
我应该试着从教皇那里
学到一些有用的东西...^000000)

scripts.text: Aren't you lonely?
scripts.translation: 你不觉得孤独吗？

scripts.text: Do you ever take a break?
scripts.translation: 你会休息吗？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Well, there are always
some priests with me all
the time. Some of them
even watch me when I sleep.
I don't think I have time
to feel lonely, actually.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
嗯，总是有牧师陪在我身边。
有些甚至在我睡觉时也在看着我。
我想，我其实没有时间去感到孤独。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Thank you for asking.
Sometimes... Sometimes
I wonder if I have a real
family. I don't even know
who'd they be or if they
exist. I don't know...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
谢谢你的关心。
有时候...有时候我会想，
我是否有真正的家人。
我甚至不知道他们是谁，
或者他们是否存在。我不知道...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I... I'm sorry.
I guess you didn't
expect to hear something
like that. ^666666*Sigh*^000000 I'm feeling
pretty exhausted. I better...
I better get some rest...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我...对不起。
我想你没想到会听到这样的话吧。^666666*叹气*^000000 我觉得很疲惫。我最好...
我最好去休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Well, even if I wanted
to, I can't just go out
and play. As pope... Well...
Everyone and everything
sort of needs my attention.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
嗯，即使我想，
我也不能随便出去玩耍。
作为教皇...嗯...
每个人和每件事都需要我的关注。

scripts.text:
[Follower]
The pope said that she's
exhausted. Please come
back when she's feeling
better, and she will have
an audience with you.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇说她很疲惫。
请等她感觉好些时再来，
她会接见你的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt sounds like they're
still talking. It'd be
best to patient and wait
just a little while longer.
Still... It's awfully boring.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF听起来他们还在谈话。
最好耐心一点，再等一会儿。
不过...这也太无聊了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA little eavesdropping
never hurt anyone. Maybe
you can hear them a little
better if you listen from
the left side of the wall.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF偷听一下也没坏处。
也许从墙的左边听，
能听得更清楚一点。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAt this distance you
can cleartly hear the
voices from the other
side of the wall...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在这个距离，
你能清楚地听到墙另一边的众声...^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
...Was it really
necessary to involve
an outsider in this
situation? Answer me!
scripts.translation:
[????]
...有必要让一个外人
卷入这件事吗？回答我！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Is this about the
accident? You know that
I've disagreed with the
actions that have led to
the mana leakage.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
这是关于那次事故吗？
你知道，我一直反对
导致玛娜泄漏的那些行动。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Even though I thought
it was a reckless decision,
I've closed the shrine and
did my best to cover up this
unfortunate accident.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
尽管我认为那是一个鲁莽的决定，
但我还是关闭了神龛，
并尽力掩盖了这场不幸的事故。

scripts.text:
[????]
I'm not blaming you. In
fact, I'll admit it: that was
our mistake. We caused
the monster infestation by
letting the mana leak.
scripts.translation:
[????]
我没有责怪你。
事实上，我承认：那是我们的错误。
我们让玛娜泄漏，导致了魔物泛滥。

scripts.text:
[????]
But that's not related
to what I'm asking you!
Do you really think it's
alright to allow an outsider
to speak to our pope during
such a tumultuous time?!
scripts.translation:
[????]
但这与我问你的无关！
你真的认为在这种动荡时期，
允许一个外人
与我们的教皇对话是合适的吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Why not? I thought it'd
bring her great comfort.
She is very confused as to
why the Holy Ground has been
closed, and she cannot know
what is happening there.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
为什么不呢？我以为这会让她感到宽慰。
她对圣地为何关闭感到非常困惑，
而且她无法得知那里正在发生什么。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Again... I strongly
disagree with what is
secretly going on over
there. I know that I can't
officially oppose this
course of action, but...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 泽德]
再说一次...我强烈反对
那边秘密进行的事情。我知道我
无法正式反对这一行动方针，但是...

scripts.text:
[????]
There's nothing to worry
about! It'll all be over before
you know it. Besides, it's
too late to turn back now,
so I warn you: don't you
dare do anything foolish.
scripts.translation:
[????]
没什么好担心的！
一切很快就会结束。况且，
现在想回头也来不及了，
所以我警告你：千万别做傻事。

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomeone's coming!
You'd better step away
from the wall and feign
ignorance as best you can!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有人来了！
你最好离开墙边，
尽量装作什么都不知道！^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Oh! You must be the one
High Priest Be- er, Zhed,
told me about. It's very nice
to meet you. High Priestess
Niren, at your service.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
哦！你一定是大祭司贝...呃，泽德
跟我提到的那个人。很高兴见到你。
我是大祭司尼伦，请多指教。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I hear that you had the
privilege of speaking with
our pope, and that she had
a wonderful time. What did
you think of her, hm?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我听说你有幸与我们的教皇对话，
而且她过得很愉快。你觉得她怎么样，嗯？

scripts.text: She's different than what I expected...
scripts.translation: 她和我想象的不太一样...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ah, I know what you mean...
Usually, most outsiders tell
me that they expect our pope
to be a wizened old man.
But that's not the case
here in Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
啊，我明白你的意思...
通常，大多数外人都告诉我，
他们以为我们的教皇是一位白发苍苍的老人。
但在阿鲁纳菲兹，情况并非如此。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Usually, our pope is chosen
by her resemblance to our
goddess Freya. She must
have silvery blond hair, snowy
skin, and divinely colored
eyes. You saw, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
通常，我们的教皇是根据她与女神芙蕾雅
的相似程度选出的。她必须拥有银金色的头发、
雪白的皮肤和神圣颜色的眼睛。你看到了，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm curious: what kinds
of things did you and the
pope talk about? As you know,
we priests are forbidden from
leaving Arunafeltz, so...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我很好奇：你和教皇
聊了些什么？你知道的，
我们牧师被禁止离开阿鲁纳菲兹，所以...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou relate the details of
your talk with the pope, but
you make sure not to mention
anything about the Holy Ground
as High Priest Zhed had asked.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你讲述了与教皇对话的细节，
但遵照大祭司泽德的嘱咐，
你没有提及任何关于圣地的事情。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ah, that's fairly
interesting, your land.
Tell me, how did you come
to know Bekento, er, I mean,
High Priest Zhed?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
啊，你的家乡听起来挺有趣的。
告诉我，你是怎么认识贝克托，呃，我是说，
大祭司泽德的？

scripts.text: Explain how You Met High Priest Zhed
scripts.translation: 解释你是如何认识大祭司泽德的

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
.........................
That's all? Hm? That's
pretty funny. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 I believe
he trusts people too much...
But that's only my opinion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
.........................
就这些？嗯？真有趣。^333333*叹气*^000000 我相信
他太容易相信别人了...
但这只是我个人的看法。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
If you don't mind...
I want to give you a bit of
advice. Don't get too close
to High Priest Zhed. If you
do, you might end up getting
yourself in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
如果你不介意的话...
我想给你一点建议。不要与大祭司泽德
走得太近。如果你这样做，
可能会给自己惹上麻烦。

scripts.text:
^3355FFHigh Priestess Niren left
as soon as she said those words.
What could she possibly mean?
For now, you may as well
talk to High Priest Zhed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF大祭司尼伦说完这些话就离开了。
她到底是什么意思？
眼下，你不妨去和大祭司泽德谈谈。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a small
shining object laid
on the floor.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现地板上放着一个
闪闪发光的小物件。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: Pick It Up
scripts.translation: 捡起来

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided to ignore
the small shining object,
no matter how important it
may be to you in the future.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你决定无视那个闪闪发光的小物件，
尽管它未来对你可能至关重要。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUpon picking up the
object, you are able to
identify it as a small key.
Perhaps you can use it to
open some kind of lock.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF捡起那个物件后，
你认出它是一把小钥匙。
也许你可以用它打开某种锁。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be the
entrance to the Holy
Ground. However, the
door in your way is locked.^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里应该是圣地的入口。
然而，挡在你面前的门被锁住了。^000000

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Use Small Key
scripts.translation: 使用小钥匙

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the Small
Key that you found in
High Priest Zhed's room,
and find that it is able
to unlock this door.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你插入了在大祭司泽德房间里找到的那把小钥匙，
发现它正好能打开这扇门。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked.^000000

^3355FFThis large area looks
like it was artificially build
for some reason-- it doesn't
seem like an area naturally
infested by monsters.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这片广阔的区域看起来像是为了某种目的而人工建造的——
这里似乎并不是魔物自然滋生的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps if you explore
this place, you'll be able
to find something interesting.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也许如果你探索一下这个地方，
就能找到一些有趣的东西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something here
beneath the water. This
may warrant a closer look.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF水底下有什么东西。
也许值得仔细看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo wonder this object
in the water seems so
familiar: it's a Ymir's
Heart Piece! In fact, there's
dozens of them just lying here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF难怪水中的这个物件看起来如此熟悉：
它是尤弥尔之心碎片！事实上，这里散落着几十块。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhy would so many of these
powerful artifacts be here
in the Holy Ground? Perhaps
this is the secret that the
priests are trying to keep.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF为什么会有这么多强大的神器出现在圣地？
也许这就是祭司们试图保守的秘密。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
How dare you intrude
the Holy Ground! Identify
yourself! I'll have you tried!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
你竟敢闯入圣地！
报上你的名号！我要审判你！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
O-oh! It's you, the
adventurer recommended
by Bekento. Hm. I apologize
for snapping at you like
that. Didn't you know that
no one's allowed here?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
哦！原来是你，
贝克托推荐的冒险者。嗯。
抱歉刚才对你那么凶。
你不知道这里禁止任何人进入吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Hmm. Well, you Rune-Midgarts
adventurers are famous for your
skills and abilities, but this
was not expected. I mean, we
made sure this place was
absolutely secure.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
嗯。好吧，卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者
以技艺高超而闻名，但这也出乎意料。
毕竟，我们确保这里绝对安全。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
What's done is done...
I warned Bekento that he
might cause trouble for you,
but it seems that you've
caused trouble for him.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
木已成舟...
我警告过贝克托，他可能会给你惹麻烦，
但看来是你给他惹了麻烦。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Understand this:
most intruders are
severely punished, but
because of my friendship
with Bekento, I'm letting
you off easy. Remember that.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
听好了：
大多数闯入者都会受到严厉惩罚，
但看在我和贝克托的交情上，
我就放过你一次。记住这一点。

scripts.text:
^3355FFNiren began to chant
in a low voice, and your
eyelids grow heavier as you
grow drowsier and sleepier...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尼伦开始低声吟唱，
你的眼皮越来越沉重，
你变得越来越困倦，最终陷入了沉睡...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel a slight headache
after you recollect your senses.
Somehow, you're been brought
back to Rachel Town. How long
have you been unconscious?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你恢复意识时，感到一阵轻微的头痛。
不知怎的，你被带回了拉赫城镇。
你昏迷了多久？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt would be best to
ask High Priest Zhed
about what had happened.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF最好去问问大祭司泽德
到底发生了什么。^000000

scripts.text:
[Arunafeltz Follower]
Excuse me, but
are you {0}?
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁纳菲兹信徒]
打扰一下，
你是{0}吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Arunafeltz Follower]
High Priest Zhed
would like to see
you right away, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁纳菲兹信徒]
大祭司泽德
想立刻见你，{0}。

scripts.text: May ask why?
scripts.translation: 请问为什么？

scripts.text:
[Arunafeltz Follower]
Well, I actually have no
idea. I'm only supposed to
inform you that he's looking
for you. Please visit High
Priest Zhed in the second
right room of the temple.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁纳菲兹信徒]
其实我也不太清楚。
我只是奉命通知您，
大祭司泽德正在找您。
请去神殿右侧第二间房间拜访他。

scripts.text:
[Arunafeltz Follower]
May Freya bless you
on your journeys...
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁纳菲兹信徒]
愿芙蕾雅保佑您的旅途...
